records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
**Lead Quality Strategy & Division Performance**
Own and advance the division’s quality strategy across the full product lifecycle—product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance. This role ensures quality is built into how products are developed, produced, tested, supported, and governed, with clear standards that protect both customers and the business.
 
 
Direct a high-performing technical and quality team by setting expectations, coaching talent, and strengthening technical capability. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing trends, preventing repeat issues, and improving product performance and operational effectiveness.
 
 
Collaborate across functions to resolve customer quality concerns, manage investigations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Lead efforts to strengthen supplier performance through clear requirements, effective feedback loops, and performance monitoring.
 
 
**What You’ll Bring**

* Deep quality and compliance knowledge spanning operations, lab/testing, and customer-facing processes
* Strong problem-solving and investigation skills, with a focus on root cause and sustainable fixes
* Proven leadership capability to develop teams and improve technical performance
* Experience partnering with suppliers and enforcing quality expectations
* Comfort managing risk and driving measurable improvement in product and operational outcomes

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Description**
**Built**
**on**
**Experience.**
**Built**
**for**
**Skill.**
**Built**
**for You.**
Keel was formed by bringing together three industry leaders combining generations of hands-on expertise in steel fabrication, shipbuilding, aerospace, and defense manufacturing.
 
 
That means when you join Keel, you’re joining a team backed by decades of proven craftsmanship and real-world results.
 
 
We build ships, defense systems, aerospace components, and heavy steel structures that serve critical missions — and we do it with pride.
 
 
**Your Mission**
The Director of Quality provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and compliance governance for multiple heavy fabrication plants producing structural weldments, assemblies, and machined components for the Nuclear Navy. This role ensures full alignment with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, and customer specific requirements.
 
 
**Explore The Depth Of The Role**

* Provide strategic leadership for quality operations across three South Carolina fabrication facilities supporting U.S. Navy shipbuilding and defense manufacturing programs.
* Ensure all products meet contractual, technical, regulatory, NAVSEA, and quality requirements while driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and product performance.
* Lead the development, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with customer, industry, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary quality interface for customers, government representatives, auditors, and regulatory agencies, leading quality reviews, audits, corrective actions, and performance discussions.
* Direct all quality assurance, quality control, inspection, test, dimensional verification, NDT, welding quality, and supplier quality activities across the region.
* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics including First-Time Quality (FTQ), Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), defect escapes, rework, audit findings, and inspection cycle time.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives to eliminate recurring nonconformances and improve manufacturing performance.
* Drive operational excellence through improved inspection efficiency, resource utilization, process standardization, and deployment of risk-based quality methodologies.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to proactively prevent defects and improve overall manufacturing effectiveness.
* Build and sustain a culture where quality, compliance, workmanship excellence, and customer focus are integrated into daily operations at all levels of the organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and lead Quality Managers, Engineers, Supervisors, Auditors, and Inspectors while building organizational capability and succession plans.
* Other related duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
**Mission Readiness:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or related technical discipline; Master's Degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in shipbuilding, defense, defense manufacturing, heavy fabrication, aerospace, or similar industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi-site quality organizations.
* Root cause analysis and corrective action applied to nonconformances and recurring defects
* Quality auditing, including internal, supplier, and customer audit planning, execution, and follow-up
* Data analysis and reporting using quality metrics, dashboards, and tools such as Excel, Power BI, and ERP/QMS software
* Contract and technical document review, including drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection plans
* Executive-level presentation and negotiation skills for customer meetings, corrective action reviews, and dispute resolution
* Quality Management Systems: AS9100, ISO 9001, Navy QA requirements, nonconformance management, and CAPA
* Welding and NDT Oversight: Weld procedures, inspection methods, and material traceability in accordance with NAVSEA requirements
* Supplier Quality: Qualifying, auditing, and developing suppliers; preventing counterfeit or nonconforming material
* Regulatory and Contract Compliance: Government source inspection, DCMA surveillance, and audit readiness
* Continuous Improvement and Leadership: Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and developing quality talent
* Track and report cost of quality (prevention, appraisal, internal and external failure) and drive reductions in rework and scrap
* Support program pricing, proposals, and forecasts with accurate quality labor and resource estimates
* Evaluate the cost, schedule, and risk impact of quality decisions, such as rework, repair, and corrective action investments

**Travel Requirements**
Between facilities as needed
 
 
**Physical Requirements**

* May be required to stand, walk, sit, reach/pull/push with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel regularly.
* May lift or carry 50lbs. Weights exceeding 50lbs will require mechanical means to maneuver.

**Become**
**a**
**part**
**of**
**our**
**Builders**
**and**
**you**
**too**
**can...**

* Uphold Safety and Quality Standards
* Embody Team Spirit
* Relentless Customer Focus
* Convey Integrity, Trust, and Professionalism
* Execute with Excellence and Velocity

**What Keel Will Build For You**

* Comprehensive Benefit Package
* Competitive Pay
* 401(k) Match
* HSA/FSA
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Time Off
* Internal Referral Bonus Opportunities
* Shift Differentials
* Overtime Potential
* Paid on the Job Training
* Certification Sponsorship Opportunities
* Committed to Individual Career Growth
* We Do Fun Things, Plus More!

**Need**
**Assistance?**
If you require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the employment process, please email talent@keelusa.com with details about your request and your contact information. Accommodation requests are reviewed individually on a case-by-case basis. Please note that this email address is monitored only for inquiries related to reasonable accommodation requests.

records.description:
**Director of Quality**

**Location:**
Springhill, TN or St. Louis, MO

**Position:**
Full-Time | Department Leadership Team

**Company Overview**

Our client is an established, growing manufacturing company specializing in custom-engineered components and solutions. With multiple manufacturing locations, the organization is committed to operational excellence, exceptional customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Quality to lead and oversee all aspects of quality management across a multi-location manufacturing organization.

This position serves as the company's senior quality leader, with overall responsibility for developing and executing the corporate quality strategy, maintaining the existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, and leading the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification.

The Director of Quality will provide leadership, direction, and professional development to all Quality Department personnel, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.

The ideal candidate will have extensive manufacturing quality experience, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record of developing quality systems, improving operational performance, and building high-performing teams.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership & Management**

* Provide company-wide leadership and oversight of all quality-related activities across the organization's manufacturing operations.
* Lead, mentor, develop, and manage the corporate Quality Department, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.
* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy, objectives, policies, and performance standards.
* Foster a proactive culture of quality, accountability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to ensure quality objectives align with business and customer requirements.
* Develop organizational capabilities, staffing plans, and employee training programs to support current operations and future growth.

**Quality Management Systems & Certification**

* Maintain and continuously improve the company's existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, ensuring ongoing compliance, audit readiness, and successful maintenance of current certification.
* Develop and manage a comprehensive IATF 16949 certification roadmap, including gap assessments, implementation milestones, resource requirements, training, internal audits, and certification readiness.
* Ensure the company's Quality Management System (QMS) is enhanced to satisfy IATF 16949 requirements and applicable customer-specific quality standards.
* Lead and execute the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification within established timelines.
* Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of quality systems and processes across all manufacturing locations.
* Oversee internal, external, customer, and certification audits, ensuring ongoing compliance and successful certification.
* Serve as, or provide leadership to, the company's Lead Auditor and internal audit teams.
* Ensure effective management of corrective and preventive actions, nonconformances, documentation, calibration, and quality records.
* Lead management reviews and ensure ongoing QMS effectiveness and organizational accountability.

**Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish, monitor, and drive improvements in company-wide Quality KPIs, including customer complaints, internal and external PPM, cost of poor quality, scrap, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives designed to reduce defects, improve manufacturing performance, and strengthen customer satisfaction.
* Lead complex problem-solving and root cause investigations using methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagrams, FMEA, and statistical analysis.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality tools to proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to establish effective process controls, inspection standards, and preventive quality measures.
* Oversee product nonconformance management, containment, material disposition, and corrective action activities.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Serve as the senior quality representative for key customer relationships, audits, escalations, and quality-related concerns.
* Ensure timely, professional resolution of customer complaints and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
* Manage the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), working closely with internal Quality and Business Development teams to ensure timely completion of customer approvals and achievement of new business launch schedules.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and ensure compliance with customer-specific quality requirements.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Purchasing to establish supplier quality expectations, manage supplier performance, and resolve supplier-related quality issues.
* Support new customer onboarding, new product launches, and manufacturing process changes to ensure quality requirements are achieved.
* Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to continuously improve quality performance.

**Strategic & Operational Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute long-term quality improvement plans aligned with the organization's growth objectives.
* Establish standardized quality processes, reporting, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Support business expansion, new manufacturing capabilities, and potential acquisitions through quality system assessments and integration.
* Evaluate and recommend investments in inspection equipment, measurement technology, automation, and quality management systems.
* Prepare and present quality performance reports, improvement plans, certification progress, and key initiatives to executive leadership.
* Promote a safe work environment and ensure quality-related activities support company safety standards.
* Perform other quality-related leadership responsibilities as required.

**Experience & Education Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and significant manufacturing quality leadership experience.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including at least 3–5 years in a quality management or leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and/or plant-level quality personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 Quality Management Systems, implementation, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or maintaining ISO 9001-certified Quality Management Systems.
* Experience supporting or leading IATF 16949 implementation, certification preparation, or certification audits.
* Lead Auditor experience with ISO 9001 or IATF 16949.
* Proven success improving quality performance, reducing defects, managing customer complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 8D, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Experience managing customer and third-party quality audits.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, ERP/MRP systems, and quality-related software.
* Ability and willingness to travel between manufacturing locations and customer or supplier facilities as necessary.
* Must be physically based in the Nashville, TN, or St. Louis, MO, metropolitan area.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience successfully leading an organization through IATF 16949 certification.
* Experience in automotive manufacturing, converting, or the production of engineered components and materials.
* Experience overseeing quality functions across multiple manufacturing facilities.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience implementing quality systems in a growing, multi-location manufacturing organization.
* Experience with supplier development, new product launches, and quality system integration.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Leadership & Personal Attributes**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and personal integrity.
* A hands-on, proactive leadership style with the ability to develop and inspire teams.
* The ability to balance strategic leadership with practical, day-to-day problem-solving.
* Strong customer focus and a commitment to delivering exceptional quality.
* An analytical, data-driven mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* A forward-thinking attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to challenge existing processes to achieve better results.
* A commitment to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and organizational success.

records.description:
**About Us**
As a global manufacturer of complex aircraft engine components, Pursuit Aerospace is founded on a commitment to relentless, continuous, operational improvement and extraordinary customer service. We pride ourselves on competitive cost structure, exceptional on-time delivery, and industry-leading quality.
 
 
Pursuit Aerospace has cultivated long-term relationships with our customers around the world through respect, teamwork, technology, and trust. We are driven to develop industry leading process innovations and manufacturing techniques on behalf of our customers. Our exceptional quality is driven by a deep investment in and the daily practice of continually improving our people, processes, and products.
 
 
**About The Opportunity**
The Quality Director reports directly to the Vice President of Operations for the division and supports sites within the division. The Quality Director duties include providing onsite support, guidance, leadership, to multiple sites within the division and champions the Company’s culture of quality and is responsible for the design and achievement of goals with respect to quality of products, services and processes for the whole of Pursuit Aerospace. In addition, ensures compliance with all regulations and provides leadership and structure to all aspects of the Quality and Quality Assurance functions across all sites. Develop, implement, manage, and continuously improve quality control systems designed to ensure accurate production of aerospace components consistent with established standards, customer specifications. Responsible for leading internal and external audits and ensuring compliance to the Quality Management System. Use Kaizen and single piece flow principles to ensure quality compliance at every process step. In addition to leading Quality at the Machining division level the Director.
 
 
**Location:**
Remote within the U.S, with travel up to 50%, including international
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and/or lead kaizen to continuously improve delivered product quality.
* Support site quality management at sites with any escalations internally or from customers.
* Drive quality to become a proactive internal function, addressing quality at the source.
* Partner closely with Site GMs, Site Quality Managers, and Division Leadership team.
* Mature site problem solving efforts.
* Led efforts to support AS9100 global certification.
* AS9100 Lead auditor training.
* Support escape investigations at sites.
* Formulate, document, and maintain quality control standards and on-going quality control objectives.
* Effectively communicate & present information to all levels of the organization – shop floor, direct reports, and management.
* Use and train in the following quality tools – root cause analysis and problem solving, FMEA, control plans, PPAP, APQP, System audits, SPC.
* Read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Working knowledge and development of quality systems and requirements and how they relate to business (i.e. AS9100, NADCAP).
* Identify and/or lead initiatives to improve Quality system compliance.
* Effective leadership skills and ability to influence department and peers, as well as be a team player.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to quality team, and will be responsible for the selection, motivation and oversight of the team for the achievement of the company goals.
* Assure all Quality staff are properly trained with the necessary equipment to yield consistent results.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or related technical discipline
* 10+ years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience including multi-site leadership
* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis without sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or who cannot work now on a full-time basis.
* Must be able to perform work subject to ITAR/EAR regulations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential
* Working knowledge of AS9100 and NADCAP special processes
* Strong command of GD&T advanced metrology tools, and data analytics/SPC tracking inside ERP systems.
* Experience aerospace manufacturing environment
* Background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action
* Experience with developing/documenting procedures.
* Excellent presentation, written, verbal and communication skills with the ability to interact and work with Employees and customers at all levels of the organization.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Computer proficiency (Microsoft Excel, Word Outlook, PowerPoint, and internet applications)

**Working Conditions**

* Must be able to have prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to frequently sit, stand and walk.
* Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 pounds.
* Personal protective equipment (e.g., safety glasses and safety shoes) is required on the shop floor

records.title: Director, Quality Assurance
records.description:
**Director, Quality Assurance**

**Onsite in Warren, NJ**

**Full-Time**

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality Assurance is a leadership role, responsible for all aspects of the Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality for the organization. The Director of Quality Assurance will work with their direct managerial reports, as well as Executive Leadership, to ensure a continued state of compliance while promoting a strong quality culture across the organization for all products, spanning early phase development to commercialization.

This position will be expected to work in a highly collaborative, cross functional team environment, and provide expert knowledge to risk identification/mitigation, strategy and execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality to assure compliance with FDA, EU, ANVISA, TGA and other international GMP requirements for all products manufactured at company (e.g., 21 CFR Part 210 + 211, EU GMP Volume 4 Part 1).
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to ensure effectiveness of Quality Systems (e.g., CAPA, Change Management, Event Management, Supplier Quality, Internal Audit, Document Management, Risk Management, Record Review and Product Disposition, Training, Field Alert/Recall, etc.)
* Will have 6 direct reports.
* Lead and ensure execution of quality strategy for all development and manufacturing activities associated with all products manufactured by company, including external GMP contract manufacture operations or laboratories for drug substance and drug product.
* Primary contact for all inspection interactions with all domestic and ex-US regulatory authorities.
* Provide direction for escalated quality issues as they arise, determining the need for, and structuring communication for, further escalation to the Executive team and/or external parties.
* Lead strategic quality to quality relationships with business partners, suppliers, external CMOs and third-party testing laboratories.
* Ensure the company is upholding to Quality/Technical Agreements with business partners and suppliers.
* Provides input to all functions to ensure clinical trial activities are conducted in compliance with GCP regulations and internal requirements.
* Actively participate in the Site Leadership Team to drive continuous improvement activities and initiatives throughout company
* Analyze, report and present metrics where applicable to show health of system(s).
* Lead GxP inspection strategies across all auditable areas to ensure the company is in an audit-ready status at all times.
* Manage overall coaching, training, development and succession planning for the function.
* Set, manage and monitor budget for Quality Assurance, in conjunction with finance.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in chemistry, engineering, biochemistry, or related science field desirable.
* Minimum 7+ years of related work experience working in a regulated GxP industry in pharmaceutical manufacturing operation setting or service-oriented laboratory.
* Demonstrated ability to direct a function, oversee projects and teams. Minimum of 2 years overseeing direct reports.
* Minimum of 2+ years working in a managerial role with direct reports.
* Strong skillset in problem solving, strategic thinking, critical reasoning and decision making.
* Strong interpersonal skills and verbal/written communication skills.
* Excellent computer skills required (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Visio).
* Strong project management skills, strong organizational skills to maintain a high level of productivity, innovation, and priority-setting to complete assignments on time and on budget.
* Strong business acumen surrounding pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Some travel required.

Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas
 
 
Coordinates the Medical Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities to measurably enhance the quality, process and cost effectiveness of patient and customer services rendered. Coordinates the Performance Improvement and Patient Safety programs in accordance with the guidelines and regulatory requirements of Federal and State regulations on a hospital-wide basis. Oversees operations of the Infection Control and Employee Health Programs. Develops and Reviews policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all regulatory and accrediting standards. Collects data to monitor compliance and/or trends.
 
 

* Institutes and monitors the Hospital’s CQI Processes, utilizing data analysis measuring tools. Oversight/coordination of operations of the Infection Control & Employee Health Program based upon hospital size and configuration.
* Assists with the design and compliance of quality processes/activities in the areas of clinical/medical staff PI for all applicable clinical/medical TJC /CARF/DOH standards. Assists with all assigned activities to assure that the hospital maintains accreditation, certification and licensure. Assumes leadership with the Joint Commission and DOH as well as other regulatory agencies with regard to CQI activities.
* Serves as a resource for all departments within the facility to provide guidance on designing, implementing, analyzing and reporting on Quality Improvement.
* Assists clinical areas in developing criteria, monitoring and reporting mechanisms and action documentation related to the hospital’s CQI program.
* Performs basic chart review activities with appropriate staff for outcome utilization, infection control and medical CQI indicators. Analyzes results of chart review activities with appropriate staff and confers with department staff on any case requiring special attention.
* Prepares analysis of significant PI findings pertaining to adverse drug reactions, drug usage evaluation, medical management of acute transfers and other CQI indicators.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse with valid state license. Legacy employees may exist with other clinical licensure.
* Requires experience in at least one of the core areas of responsibility: Quality, Survey Readiness, Risk Management, Infection Control, Employee Health and Education
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including TJC and CARF preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in Quality Improvement, with Statistical Process Control experience and computer skills preferred.
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including JCAHO and CARF preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) preferred

records.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
 
 
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
 
 
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
 
 
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

records.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

records.description:
We are a fast-paced business with ambitious growth plans; so if you are dedicated, enthusiastic and always seeking ways to improve, you'll enjoy a career with us!
 
 
Director of Quality
 
 
**Weston - Florida, USA | Permanent | Full-time**
**About Ontic Weston**
Weston is Ontic's newest site and an important part of the next stage of our growth in the US.
 
 
Acquired in 2026, the 130,000 sq ft facility will become a dedicated Original Equipment production site, complementing our MRO Center of Excellence in nearby Miramar. Together, our two South Florida locations give Ontic the space and capability to continue expanding as customer demand grows.
 
 
Joining Weston at this stage means more than joining a new facility. You'll have the opportunity to help build it - shaping teams, ways of working and culture as we prepare the site for operations in 2027. If you're energised by growth, change and the chance to create something from the ground up, this is a rare opportunity to do exactly that.
 
 
The opportunity
 
 
Lead Quality for an aerospace manufacturing operation where reliability and customer confidence are fundamental. At Weston, you'll shape the way quality is built into products and processes while supporting a growing site's operational priorities.
 
 
You'll lead Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection activities, working with operations and external stakeholders to strengthen compliance, resolve complex issues and drive lasting improvements in product and process quality.
 
 
What you'll be doing
 
 

* Lead and develop Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams, setting clear expectations and priorities.
* Develop, install and then maintain effective quality management systems and applicable aerospace certification requirements.
* Represent Quality with customers and government quality representatives, resolving issues constructively.
* Oversee quality planning, contract reviews, audits, material review activity and corrective actions.
* Partner across functions on new products, product integration and transitions into production.
* Use quality measures and root-cause analysis to reduce defects, scrap, warranty costs and repeat issues.
* Build a culture of prevention, accountability and continuous improvement.

What you'll bring
 
 

* At least 10 years of aerospace Quality experience in an AS9100 manufacturing environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* A bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant discipline, plus knowledge of AS9100 internal auditing.
* Experience leading Quality Engineering, Quality Control and inspection teams in high-mix aerospace manufacturing.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, Federal Aviation Administration and Department of Defense requirements, and applicable contract clauses.
* Experience with audits, customer approvals, contract reviews, material review and corrective action.
* Strong structured problem-solving and executive stakeholder communication skills.
* Lean or Six Sigma experience and FAA designated manufacturing inspection representative training or certification would be advantageous.

Why Ontic?
 
 
At Ontic, we're specialists in keeping critical aircraft flying. Our work supports civil and military aviation around the world, giving established aircraft products the long-term support they need to remain safe, reliable and available.
 
 
But it's our people who make that possible. We're a growing, global team where you're trusted to take ownership, encouraged to challenge how things have always been done and supported to develop your career as our business grows.
 
 
We believe in embracing the challenge - working together to solve complex problems and create opportunities for our customers, our business and each other.
 
 
Benefits at Ontic
 
 
At Ontic, we're committed to supporting our people to thrive - at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development and financial security, while giving everyone the opportunity to share in our success.
 
 

* Goal Share bonus program - everyone at Ontic is automatically enrolled, giving us all the opportunity to share in our success
* Paid volunteering time - giving you time to support a cause or community that matters to you
* 24/7 wellbeing support - confidential support available through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee discounts - access to discounts and offers across a range of retailers and services
* Learning and development - opportunities to build your skills, develop your career and grow with Ontic
* Employee referral program - rewarding you for introducing great people to Team Ontic
* Comprehensive medical insurance
* Competitive PTO, holiday pay and sick leave
* 401(k) plan - with up to 4% company match
* 9/80 work schedule - where applicable

Ready to embrace the challenge?
 
 
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity where you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and see where a career with Team Ontic could take you.
 
 
**Compensation Pay Range**

records.title: Vice President Quality Control
records.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice President, Quality Control based in the United States.**
The Vice President, Quality Control will provide strategic leadership for a global laboratory network supporting clinical development and commercial manufacturing programs. Reporting to the Chief Quality Officer, this executive will define and implement an enterprise-wide Quality Control strategy, ensuring scientific excellence, regulatory compliance, reliable data, and timely product release. The role oversees a broad range of laboratory operations across multiple sites and product modalities, while driving standardization, digital transformation, and operational performance. Working closely with senior executives, strategic clients, and regulatory authorities, the successful candidate will influence investment decisions, strengthen inspection readiness, and protect continuity of supply. This is an opportunity to shape a high-performing global organization and make a meaningful contribution to product quality and patient safety.
 
 
Accountabilities
 
 

* Define and execute the global Quality Control strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap across sites, product modalities, and development stages. Establish consistent enterprise standards, governance structures, and decision-making responsibilities while accommodating justified site-specific requirements.
* Provide executive oversight of end-to-end Quality Control operations, including analytical, biochemical, biological, microbiological, raw-material, in-process, release, and stability testing, as well as environmental and utility monitoring. Ensure laboratory capacity, priorities, and execution support program milestones, product disposition, client commitments, and uninterrupted supply.
* Govern the analytical method lifecycle from early development through transfer, qualification, validation, comparability, continued performance verification, and retirement. Ensure testing strategies and specifications evolve appropriately throughout clinical development, process performance qualification, product launch, and commercial supply.
* Establish global expectations for current good manufacturing practice, applicable good laboratory practice principles, data governance and integrity, laboratory investigations, out-of-specification and out-of-trend management, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, change control, and audit readiness. Lead enterprise-level regulatory inspection strategies and responses to critical client audits.
* Drive the global laboratory digital and technology roadmap, including laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, laboratory execution systems, chromatography data systems, automation, advanced analytics, and instrument connectivity. Sponsor validated technology deployment, master-data governance, cybersecurity, and adoption to improve accuracy, efficiency, and cycle times.
* Lead enterprise capacity planning, capital investment prioritization, make-versus-buy decisions, laboratory footprint strategy, and oversight of external testing partners. Align resources and contingency plans with demand forecasts, technology transfers, new product introductions, and network resilience requirements.
* Establish enterprise performance metrics and management reviews covering testing and release timelines, lead times, invalid results, out-of-specification and out-of-trend rates, investigation cycle times, corrective and preventive action effectiveness, stability execution, method performance, cost, and productivity. Promote risk-based decision-making, Lean practices, and cross-site learning.
* Act as the senior Quality Control representative for strategic clients, regulatory authorities, and executive governance. Translate complex technical and compliance risks into clear business implications, negotiate scientifically sound solutions, and ensure commitments are realistic and consistently delivered.
* Build and lead a global organization through senior leaders. Develop organizational capabilities, succession plans, technical career paths, and communities of practice while fostering scientific rigor, transparency, accountability, inclusion, and proactive risk management.
* Lead escalations and coordinated responses to significant Quality Control events, laboratory constraints, data-integrity concerns, assay failures, method or specification issues, and testing disruptions. Make or recommend risk-based decisions regarding testing strategies, product impact, remediation, and continuity of supply.
* Perform additional responsibilities in support of the broader Global Quality strategy and organizational objectives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, with at least 15 years of progressive Quality Control experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) sector; alternatively, a Master's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* At least 10 years of people-management experience, including a minimum of five years leading senior leaders with responsibility for multiple laboratories, sites, or functional areas.
* Demonstrated leadership of Quality Control operations across clinical development and commercial manufacturing, including analytical method transfer, qualification and validation, release and stability testing, microbiology, and environmental and utility monitoring.
* Proven experience managing global regulatory inspections and client audits, as well as complex out-of-specification, out-of-trend, data-integrity, and laboratory-compliance matters.
* Experience overseeing budgets, capital investment portfolios, headcount, laboratory capacity, external testing partners, and enterprise transformation initiatives within a complex, matrixed global organization.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, and client-facing skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific and regulatory matters clearly and influence strategic decisions.
* An advanced scientific degree and/or a Master of Business Administration is preferred.
* Global leadership experience within a CDMO supporting biologics, vaccines, advanced therapies, or sterile manufacturing is highly desirable.
* Experience scaling Quality Control capabilities from clinical development through process performance qualification, product launch, and sustained commercial supply is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of relevant regulatory authorities, standards, and guidance, including the US Food and Drug Administration, European Medicines Agency, Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency, and Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency.
* Familiarity with International Council for Harmonisation guidelines Q2, Q5, Q6, Q9, Q10, and Q14; United States Pharmacopeia; European Pharmacopoeia; Japanese Pharmacopoeia; Title 21 of the Code of Federal Regulations Parts 210, 211, and 11; European Union Good Manufacturing Practice Annexes 1 and 11; and applicable data-integrity expectations.
* Experience implementing global laboratory information management systems and laboratory digitalization and automation initiatives is preferred.
* Professional credentials from the American Society for Quality, along with Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent quality and operational excellence training, are valued.

**Benefits**

* Annual salary range of $272,000–$325,000, with compensation determined by work location and relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.
* Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.
* Health Savings Account option with company contributions.
* Industry-leading 401(k) savings plan.
* Insurance coverage and employee assistance programs.
* Wellness incentives designed to support overall health and well-being.
* Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays.
* A supportive environment that encourages personal and professional development.
* Global scope, with the role supporting sites worldwide. Compensation and benefits are governed by the location designated as the employee's home site.

**How Jobgether Works**
We use an
**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
 
 
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 
 
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
 
 
**Data Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
 
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our client, an organization that provides comprehensive outpatient and inpatient mental health services, is hiring a
**Vice President of Quality Management, RN.**
The Vice President of Quality Management, RN, will provide executive leadership while remaining actively engaged in day-to-day quality operations. The role is designed for a hands-on, player-coach leader who can guide the quality team, strengthen performance, and contribute directly to departmental priorities.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support the quality management function at both strategic and operational levels.
* Serve as an engaged player-coach who works directly with the team and remains involved in execution.
* Provide guidance, direction, and leadership to quality management professionals.
* Promote effective quality practices and continuous operational improvement.
* Represent the quality function with strong executive presence and sound professional judgment.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated leadership experience in quality management.
* Ability to operate as a hands-on leader while effectively coaching and developing a team.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership.
* Proven ability to work in the details while maintaining a strategic perspective.
* Excellent judgment, collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
* Preferred educational background, required years of experience, certifications, travel expectations, and additional technical qualifications were not provided and should be confirmed before publication.

Some of the Benefits

records.title: VP Operations
records.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions.
 
 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence.
 
 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
include, but not limited to the following.
 
 

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
**Vice President Quality**

**Global Product Distribution Quality**

**The Opportunity**

Our client is a leading global medical technology company looking to appoint a hands-on VP Global Product Distribution Quality. Reporting directly to the SVP of Corporate Quality, you will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies to effectively manage all global product distribution quality. In this role, you will lead the global product distribution quality organization and processes, holding quality management accountability for all captive and outsourced distribution centres across every entity worldwide.

This is a genuine turnaround and organizational design mandate, rather than a caretaker or step-up role. You will step in to stabilize day-to-day operations, manage significant FDA and global regulatory scrutiny, and reshape the commercial quality infrastructure into a world-class function. For a seasoned executive who enjoys building progressive systems at scale, there is a clear path to expanded enterprise responsibility within 6 to 20 months.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Distribution Governance:**
 Own quality management systems/compliance performance across captive/3PL distribution centres globally - alongside full P&L, budget, and headcount accountability for the function.
* **Turnaround & Future-State Design:**
 Audit current teams, workflows, and systems to close compliance gaps, restructuring the global commercial quality organization into a streamlined, best-in-class model.
* **FDA & Global Regulatory Execution:**
 Act as the single accountable global executive for all distribution-related regulatory inspections, audit responses, and direct agency communications, including intensive FDA engagement.
* **Quality Systems & Digital Traceability:**
 Direct the IT partnership to optimize warehouse management systems (WMS), end-to-end product traceability, inventory controls, and nonconforming product containment.
* **Enterprise Leadership:**
 Serve as the global subject matter expert for distribution quality and contribute to enterprise-wide quality strategy as a senior member of the Global Corporate Quality leadership team.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Sitting or Recent Med-Tech VP:**
 Minimum 10 years of global organizational leadership at the Vice President level within medical devices, capital equipment, or adjacent life sciences—ready to deliver impact from day one.
* **Post-Manufacturing & 3PL Mastery:**
 Deep operational expertise in commercial, supply chain, and global distribution quality across multi-site networks (upstream supplier quality into manufacturing is out of scope).
* **Proven Remediation Track Record:**
 Demonstrated success leading quality turnarounds, organizational redesigns, and systemic remediation under active FDA scrutiny.
* **Global Trade & Customs Compliance:**
 Hands-on command of international medical device regulations, import/export laws, embargoes, import bans, and regional market-entry barriers.
* **Academic Foundation:**
 Bachelor of Science in a medical or applied science discipline

**What Sets You Apart**

You lead from the front with high energy and a clear appetite for complex turnarounds. You combine sharp analytical rigor with executive presence, enabling you to influence across commercial, supply chain, and regulatory stakeholders while building high-performing global teams.

records.description:
VP of Quality – Structural Steel & Bridge Fabrication

**Confidential Fabricator**

The cost of poor quality rarely sits in one department.

Production loses hours to repairs.

Project managers spend time chasing answers.

Shipping loses its window.

And the customer remembers who had to explain the delay.

That’s when quality becomes a leadership issue.

A large-scale structural steel and bridge fabricator is hiring a
**VP of Quality**
to set the quality strategy and make it work across engineering, fabrication and project delivery.

You’ll set expectations with department leaders, use data on rework and audit findings to decide where to act first, and build a quality team that can support the business as it grows.

You’ll need the technical credibility to challenge a welding or inspection decision and the judgment to know when a recurring issue calls for investment, a process change or clearer ownership.

**What they’re looking for**

* Senior quality leadership in structural steel, bridge fabrication or comparable heavy welded fabrication
* Experience owning a quality management system and leading quality managers or inspection teams
* Strong knowledge of AWS D1.1, AWS D1.5 and AISC certification requirements
* Evidence of measurable improvements in rework, delivery performance or customer outcomes
* Confidence representing the business with customers, auditors and third-party inspectors

**Why it’s worth a conversation**

* Executive influence over how quality decisions are made across the business
* State-of-the-art facility: 2000+ tonnes a month
* Complex steel and bridge work where those decisions have a real impact on cost and delivery
* Scope to shape the quality team, systems and standards as the business grows

If you’ve changed how a fabrication business manages quality, I’d like to hear what you changed and what improved.

**Apply on LinkedIn or message me directly for a confidential conversation.**

records.title: Vice President of Quality
records.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Your Job**
Georgia Pacific is seeking a Plant Manager for our Lumber facility in Rome, GA. The Plant Manager will provide leadership to drive continuous improvement in Safety, Productivity, Cost, Customer Experience, and site profitability, in alignment with Principle Based Management (PBM).
 
 
Rome is a beautiful city with a thriving downtown area surrounded by colleges, medical care, rivers, lakes, and rolling hillsides. The location offers both city and country living and is close to metropolitan areas as well.
 
 
The preferred candidate for this excellent opportunity will be:
 
 

* A dynamic leader who coaches and develops others, fostering a contribution-motivated, results-driven team
* A champion of Environmental, Health, and Safety, modeling stewardship and compliance
* Able to set direction and empower the team, leveraging comparative advantage to maximize results
* Skilled at motivating others to self-actualize and contribute at their highest level
* Able to drive transformation and build a thriving, principle-based culture in a union environment

**What You Will Do**

* Lead the overall operation of the facility, applying principled based leadership from raw material receipt to finished product shipment
* Ensure alignment with business vision and drive high performance in safety, environmental compliance, production, quality, and financial results
* Select and develop a team of Principled Entrepreneurs who create long-term value and eliminate waste
* Foster a culture of knowledge sharing, challenge, and continuous improvement
* Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, laws, and regulations
* Build productive relationships with peers and support functions (procurement, sales, accounting, HR, etc.)
* Engage and connect team members at all levels, promoting mutual benefit and respect
* Strive to make Georgia-Pacific Rome Lumber the supplier and employer of choice

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Three (3) or more years leading manufacturing processes in a wood products including operations excellence, maintenance, reliability, quality, and continuous improvement
* Demonstrated ability to lead profitable change and transformation
* Experience managing direct reports, assessing talent, providing coaching and feedback, compensation management, and developing future talent
* Understanding of budgeting/expense management and financial practices
* Experience with EH&S management systems, risk assessment/mitigation, and project planning
* Commitment to working safely and promoting a culture of stewardship and compliance
* Experience formulating and implementing business improvement strategies

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Engineering or Wood Science
* Multiple years of progressive experience in a wood products facility in one or more of the following positions: Plant Manager, Production Manager, Plant Superintendent, Reliability or Maintenance Manager, or in an equivalent leadership role
* Large capital project Engineering or Management experience
* Experience implementing and using continuous improvement tools to drive improvement
* Experience in a union environment

*At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.*
**Hiring Philosophy**
All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.
 
 
**Who We Are**
As a Koch company and a leading manufacturer of bath tissue, paper towels, paper-based packaging, cellulose, specialty fibers, building products and much more, Georgia-Pacific works to meet evolving needs of customers worldwide with quality products. In addition to the products we make, we operate one of the largest recycling businesses. Our more than 30,000 employees in over 150 locations are empowered to innovate every day – to make everyday products even better.
 
 
At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.
 
 
**Our Benefits**
Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.
 
 
Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.
 
 
**Equal Opportunities**
Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify. Please click here for additional information. (For Illinois E-Verify information click here, aquí, or tu).
