records.description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you—innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
 
 
**Led by Purpose. Driven by You.**

 
 

The Senior Director, Master Data Management & Operations (MDM) will lead the enterprise master data capability. They will establish clear ownership and operating discipline so that critical business data is accurate, trusted, and ready to support the business.

 

Reporting to the VP Data & AI, the Senior Director, MDM will lead a global team of 65 with three direct reports focused on 1) functional data domains 2) engineering and tooling 3) supporting transformation and operations.

 

This leader will play a central role in a multi-year enterprise transformation and integration agenda, ensuring master data is ready to support major system and business changes. They will balance near-term delivery priorities with the long-term target state, while supporting existing systems alongside modern governance platforms; as well as focus on:

 

* **End to End master data ownership**: Own master data across all functions, regions, and business segments. Establish clear accountability, decision rights, and drive decisions and escalations.
 

* **Integration and program delivery**: Lead master data readiness for large-scale enterprise integration and transformation efforts. This includes integration experience, comfort operating at scale in a matrix, and the ability to influence senior business leaders across the company.
 

**Role & Responsibilities**
 
The Senior Director, MDM serves as a key transformational leader who will be responsible for:

**Enterprise Master Data Strategy**

* Define and own the enterprise master data strategy, setting a clear direction for how master data will be owned, governed, and used to run the business with confidence.
* Establish the operating model and talent strategy needed to manage master data end to end.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to align priorities, investments, and capabilities to enterprise objectives.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for master data, translating data strategy into measurable business outcomes.
 

**Engineering & Tooling Ownership**

* Own the master data engineering and tooling agenda, setting the target-state architecture and roadmap for master data platforms, integrations, and supporting tools.
* Drive standardization and simplification of the master data tooling landscape, rationalizing redundant and legacy tools in favor of common enterprise platforms.
* Use tooling to drive efficiency, consistency, and simplification of master data processes, embedding standards, data quality rules, and governance directly into the workflow.
Drive intelligent automation of master data processes, applying workflow automation, AI, and machine learning to reduce manual effort, accelerate cycle times, and improve data quality. 

**Enterprise Integration & Transformation**

* Lead master data readiness for large-scale enterprise integration and transformation programs.
* Oversee master data enablement for ERP transformation, including harmonization, integration, and migration efforts.
* Balance near-term delivery priorities with the long-term target state.
Support existing systems alongside modern governance platforms as the enterprise transitions. 

**Business Partnership & Influence**

* Collaborate with senior business and technology leaders across the enterprise to align master data capabilities to critical business domains.
Influence in a matrix environment, driving decisions and escalations rather than acting as a subject matter expert or order taker. 

**Functional Leadership**

* Develop a global, multi-disciplinary team spanning domain ownership, technology and tooling, and program operations.
* Coach and mentor leaders, attracting top talent and creating an environment where data professionals do their best work.
Integrate teams and capabilities through shared priorities, standards, and operating rhythms. 

**Experience We're Looking For:** 
 
The Senior Director, MDM will have a proven track record leading master data at large, global organizations, with deep expertise across master data management, data quality, stewardship, governance, integration, and data product ownership. This leader will ideally bring experience in CPG or adjacent, complex consumer-oriented industries such as Pharmaceuticals, Retail, or Manufacturing, including exposure to regulated or restricted products. Experience in mergers, acquisitions, and large-scale enterprise integration is highly valued. Familiarity with enterprise ERP environments and modern master data governance platforms is helpful.

Equally important is the ability to operate as a strategic, influential leader who can partner with senior business and technology leaders, drive decisions and escalations, and influence in a large, matrixed organization. The Senior Director, MDM will be comfortable with complexity and change, able to set clear direction for a global team. They will bring strong execution, attention to detail, and a collaborative, action-oriented leadership style, with a record of building, coaching, and mentoring high-performing teams.

**Functional Skills & Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience, including accountability for complex, end-to-end master data in large, matrixed enterprises.
* Deep expertise in master data management, governance, data quality, stewardship, standards, and adoption.
* Proven success owning master data end to end across functions, regions, and business segments.
* Experience leading M&A, enterprise integration, and ERP-enabled master data harmonization, migration, and consolidation.
* Demonstrated success establishing data product ownership models with clearly defined domain owners.
* Experience in CPG or adjacent, complex consumer-oriented industries, such as Pharmaceuticals, Retail, or Manufacturing, including exposure to regulated or restricted products.
* Familiarity with enterprise ERP environments and modern master data governance platforms.
* Experience supporting legacy and multi-region systems alongside modern governance platforms during a multi-year transition.
* Track record leading global, geographically dispersed teams through significant integration, transformation, and ambiguity.
* Proven ability to deliver near-term program priorities while executing against a long-term target state.
 

 

**Leadership Capabilities**·
 
**Strategic influence:** Operates as a strategic leader with gravitas who can partner with senior business and technology leaders and influence decisions.
 
 
**Enterprise transformation leadership:** Sets clear direction and turns strategy into disciplined execution across people, processes, and technology.
 
 
**Operating at scale:** Works effectively in large, matrixed environments where master data touches every function, region, and segment.
 
 
**Execution orientation:** Brings strong execution and attention to detail, with a record of delivering against complex, multi-year programs.

 

**Collaborative, action-oriented style:** Works well with a collaborative leadership team and adds an accountable, execution-focused approach.

 

**Talent and culture leadership:** Attracts and develops strong talent, inspires high-performing teams, and unites newly formed organizations around shared priorities, decision rights, operating rhythms, and ways of working.
 
 
**Education Credentials** 
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, information systems, technology, or related discipline required. MBA or advanced degree is an added benefit.
 
 
**Total Benefits** 
 
We believe that our employees are our greatest asset, and we're committed to providing them with the resources they need to be successful. If you're looking for a rewarding career with a company that cares about its employees, then Kimberly-Clark is the place for you.
 
 
Here are just a few of the benefits you’d enjoy working in this role for Kimberly-Clark. For a complete overview, see www.mykcbenefits.com .
 
 
**To Be Considered** 
 
Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.
 
 
In the meantime, please check out the careers website.
 
 
**And finally, the fine print….**

*For Kimberly-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers. When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. We are a committed equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* 
 
*The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this classification. Statements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and skills required for this position.* 
 
*Employment is subject to verification of local policies.* 
 
*Employment is subject to verification of pre-screening tests which may include drug screening, background check, and DMV check.* 
 
*Veterans and members of the Reserve and Guard are highly encouraged to apply.*

Salary Range: 221,300 – 286,100 USD

At Kimberly-Clark, pay is just one aspect of our total rewards package, which also includes a variety of benefits and opportunities to achieve, thrive and grow. Along with base pay, this position offers eligibility for a target bonus and a comprehensive benefits suite, including our 401(k) and Profit Sharing plan. The anticipated base pay range for this role is provided above for a fully qualified hire. Actual pay will depend on several factors, such as location, role, skills, performance, and experience. Please note that the stated pay range applies to US locations only.

------------

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

records.title: Head of Quality
records.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related area of study

**Experience:**

* At minumum15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience with at least 10 years of Quality experience, both QC and QA in biopharma/biotech in a CGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with early and late-stage products.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience driving Quality strategy, compliance initiatives, continuous improvement and staff development.
* Extensive experience developing, implementing and improving quality systems directly related to biologics drug substance manufacturing CGMP
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities with global health authorities with demonstrated success in leading a company through cGMP pre-approval and post-approval inspections.
* Proven ability to build and sustain a transparent, collaborative, and quality-focused culture that promotes accountability, engagement, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change within complex regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to develop staff at all levels.
Experience with developing and managing budgets. 

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory requirements and quality standards, including US FDA, EMA, PIC/S, and ICH guidelines.
* Demonstrated success in leading organizations through sound decision-making, strategic problem-solving, and effective communication at all levels of the business.
* Prior experience within a CDMO environment is strongly preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex quality and compliance matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support teams through crisis management, organizational transformation, cultural change, and business growth initiatives.
* Highly adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.
* Strong leadership capability with a demonstrated ability to empower teams, identify high-potential talent, and drive employee development and succession planning.
* Results-oriented leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Skilled at building trusted relationships and collaborating effectively with cross-functional peers, senior leadership, clients, and regulatory agencies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in biological or chemical sciences
* Experience with US FDA, China FDA, Health Canada, EMEA, PMDA, and ANVISA is preferred
* Knowledge of and experience with GLP and/or GCP regulatory inspections a plus
Strong operational excellence experience or qualification 

Base Salary Range 192000-270000

 
 

**Compensation and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing, including:

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plans with employer matching contributions
* Paid time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee wellness programs and resources
* Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

**Core Values**

*At Bora, our values guide everything we do — from how we solve challenges to how we support our people. We lead with a solutions-first mindset, strive to do the right thing, stay proactive, and above all, respect everyone.*

Bora Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees according to all applicable equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, directives and regulations of federal, state and local governing bodies and agencies. In keeping with this commitment, Bora Pharmaceuticals will recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including factors related to pregnancy or child birth), national origin, age, marital status, familial status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity status with regard to public assistance, employment status, local human rights commission activity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, atypical hereditary cellular or blood trait, or any other protected category.

postedPay.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean

records.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.

The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Required Qualifications: 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

Preferred Qualifications: 

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

Position Success Criteria: 

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale
* Excellent communication at every level, from the shop floor to the executive leadership team

The expected annual salary range for this role is $203000 - $297000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.

You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.

We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

records.title: Director of Transit Products Manufacturing
records.description:
**DIRECTOR OF TRANSIT PRODUCTS MANUFACTURING**

**Position Summary**

Reporting directly to the President, the Director of Transit Products Manufacturing is responsible for providing strategic leadership and operational oversight for all Transit Products manufacturing operations. This role drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, cost optimization, productivity enhancement, quality assurance, and workforce development while supporting the company's growth objectives.

The Director partners closely with Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, and Human Resources to align manufacturing capacity and performance with customer demand, financial objectives, and long-term business strategy. The successful candidate will foster a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and employee engagement while delivering exceptional operational results.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities as management may deem necessary from time to time.*

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide leadership and direction for all Transit Products manufacturing operations.
* Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that support company growth, profitability, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction objectives.
* Partner with the Executive Team to establish departmental goals, priorities, budgets, and long-term operational plans.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and continuous improvement efforts across manufacturing functions.
* Build and maintain a high-performance culture through coaching, accountability, employee engagement, and leadership development.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Oversee the execution of production plans to meet customer commitments while optimizing labor, equipment, and facility utilization.
* Identify operational constraints, process inefficiencies, and capacity limitations, and lead corrective actions to improve performance.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive data-based decision making and accountability.
* Develop and implement initiatives that improve throughput, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and lower operational costs.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the organization.

**Quality & Safety**

* Maintain a safe working environment and ensure compliance with all company policies, safety regulations, and applicable laws.
* Promote a culture where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are fundamental operating principles.
* Ensure products consistently meet or exceed customer specifications and quality standards.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities to prevent recurring quality and operational issues.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Operations Planning, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to align manufacturing performance with sales forecasts, customer demand, inventory requirements, and financial goals.
* Partner with Engineering to support new product introductions, process improvements, and manufacturability initiatives.
* Work closely with the ERP team to maximize the utilization and effectiveness of ERP systems and related technologies to improve operational visibility and performance.

**People Development**

* Develop, mentor, and build strategies to retain manufacturing leaders and team members.
* Establish clear performance expectations and provide regular coaching, feedback, and development opportunities.
* Support succession planning and organizational development to ensure long-term operational stability and growth.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Participate in daily operational reviews to address production performance, scheduling, delivery commitments, and operational issues.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, improvement initiatives, and strategic plans to executive leadership.
* As a member of the AROW Global leadership team, understand and support the AROW Business System, policies, objectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior management role.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations in a growth-oriented environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team development skills.
* Experience managing budgets, operational metrics, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems; IFS experience preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Transit, Transportation, Bus, Specialty Vehicle, Metal Fabrication, or Industrial Manufacturing environments.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement certification and experience.
* Proven track record of implementing operational excellence initiatives that improve quality, delivery performance, productivity, and profitability.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, communicate, hear, and use hands to handle tools, equipment, and office materials. Periodic business travel will be required on an infrequent basis.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

AROW is an Equal Opportunity and Human Rights Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, provincial, and local employment laws at its U.S. and Canadian locations.

records.description:
The **Director of Operations** - Production Kitchen provides strategic and hands-on leadership for Taher's Plymouth, MN manufacturing operation. This role is responsible for leading safe, efficient, high-quality, and cost-effective production across food manufacturing, meal assembly, packaging, warehousing, logistics coordination, maintenance partnership, food safety, and continuous improvement.

This leader will help position the Production Kitchen for growth by strengthening operating discipline, improving production flow, developing leaders, supporting audit readiness, and ensuring Taher delivers consistent, chef-driven products that meet customer, regulatory, and company expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily operations for Taher's Plymouth Production Kitchen, including production, packaging, warehousing, and cross-functional manufacturing support.
* Ensure safety, food quality, service, production attainment, labor efficiency, and cost expectations are met consistently.

* Develop and execute operational plans aligned with company growth and financial objectives.
* Establish clear performance expectations, operating rhythms, and accountability throughout the operations organization.

Partner with the VP of Operations

* - Manufacturing, Plant Manager, FSQA, culinary, purchasing, finance, HR, and logistics teams to align priorities and remove barriers.

**Manufacturing and Production**

* Oversee high-volume food production, meal assembly, sandwich production, packaging, and related manufacturing activities.

* Monitor production performance and implement improvements in labor efficiency, throughput, yield, downtime, and capacity utilization.

* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining food safety, allergen control, product quality, labeling accuracy, and customer specifications.

* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and constraints.
* Lead efforts to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and manufacturing performance.

**Food Safety and Quality**

* Promote and maintain a strong food safety and quality culture throughout the organization.
* Ensure compliance with applicable food safety, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Partner with FSQA leadership to maintain audit readiness and compliance with HACCP, GMP, SQF, FDA, USDA, allergen, environmental monitoring, sanitation, and documentation requirements.

* Support investigations and corrective actions related to food safety, quality, customer complaints, and production issues.
* Ensure operational teams understand and consistently follow food safety and quality procedures.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, productivity, cost reduction, and service.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, and other improvement methodologies as appropriate.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators and use data to drive decision-making.
* Reduce waste, improve yields, minimize downtime, and increase manufacturing efficiency.
* Implement standardized operating procedures and best practices across facilities.

**Maintenance and Engineering**

* Partner with maintenance and engineering teams to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Participate in capital planning and prioritize investments that improve safety, capacity, quality, and operational performance.
* Lead or support equipment, automation, and facility improvement projects.

**Supply Chain and Customer Service**

* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, and Logistics teams to ensure efficient flow of materials and finished goods.
* Support production planning and inventory management to optimize customer service and working capital.
* Improve communication and coordination between operations and commercial teams.
* Ensure operational readiness for new products, customer requirements, and business growth.

**Financial Performance**

* Manage operational budgets and support the development of annual operating plans.
* Identify and execute cost savings and margin improvement initiatives.
* Monitor labor, materials, overhead, waste, and other key operational costs.
* Support capital investment decisions and ensure projects deliver expected business results.
* Drive operational performance that supports revenue growth and profitability.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop production managers, supervisors, line leads, machine operators, warehouse associates, maintenance partners, and other operational team members.
* Build a culture of accountability, teamwork, food safety discipline, urgency, employee engagement, and continuous improvement.

* Establish succession and development plans for key operations positions.
* Promote effective communication across shifts, departments, and locations.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and organizational capability to meet business objectives.

**Benefits**

* Medical & Dental
* Doctegrity Telemedical
* 401k
* Sick Time
* Vacation Time
* Lifemart Corporate Discount program
* Bonus structure
* Free turkey for Thanksgiving

**Who We Are:**

Taher, Inc. is a family-owned and operated, chef-driven, food service management company. We specialize in providing K-12 school lunch management, campus dining, senior dining, catering, vending, and office beverage services to clients in our growing nationwide footprint.

Customers choose Taher for its chef-developed recipes created from natural and sustainable local sources, and for delivering the latest in culinary trends and operational resources to provide outstanding food options for our guests. Taher maintains a consistent presence in Food Service Management's Top 25 companies.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Food Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
8* -12+ years of progressive operations, food manufacturing, production, logistics, or plant leadership experience.
* Experience in food manufacturing, ready-to-eat foods, bakery, commissary, packaged goods, meal assembly, or high-volume production strongly preferred.

* Experience leading manufacturing operations in a high-volume, fast-paced production environment.
* Demonstrated success improving productivity, quality, service, and manufacturing costs.
* Strong knowledge of food safety, quality systems, HACCP, GMP, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, OEE, and operational performance management.
* Strong financial and business acumen.
* Proven leadership, coaching, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Multi-site operations experience preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational leadership and execution
* Manufacturing excellence
* Food safety and quality focus
* Continuous improvement
* Financial and business acumen
* Data-driven decision-making
* Problem-solving and root-cause analysis
* Team leadership and talent development
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Change management
* Accountability and results orientation

records.title: Plant Director
records.description:
**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Director oversees and manages the overall manufacturing effort of the Rochester Site. He/she is responsible for the profit and loss of the facility through the coordination and management of manufacturing, tooling, human resources, quality assurance, finance, and continuous improvement for the location in support of the overall company objectives. May take part in development of functional strategy. Leads the site's use of AI and automation, in the office and on the shop floor, to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

At Crenlo we invest in our people. Our overall success is contributed to our employees' skills and talents, which have been impactful and essential to the growth of our business. Here, you will get the opportunity to test your knowledge and skills and become a critical player.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Directs the overall operations of the facility and all departments within
* Establish sound strategies and tactics aimed towards continued quality, safety, cost improvement and OTD (on-time delivery) of products
* Oversee management review of quality systems and encourages a lean operation by driving continuous improvement, proactive management, and teamwork
* Ensure that facility is properly staffed and trained
* Represents facility to potential customers, clients, and at corporate meetings
* Bears overall responsibility for housekeeping of facility and safety awareness
* Communicates plant financial & operational condition to Corporate
* Manage the operations cost to enhance profitability while staying within legal guidelines and company policies and procedures
* Responsible for the strategy and long-term planning of the operations to ensure continued success in meeting customer expectations
* **Office AI streamlining:** Use AI tools to cut manual work in reporting, daily management prep, shortage and expedite lists, shift reports, and Oracle EBS data cleanup (lead times, BOMs), so leaders spend less time building spreadsheets and more time on the floor
* **Shop floor AI deployment:** Lead pilots and rollout of AI and vision tools on the shop floor. Select AI and automation projects by payback, run pilots, measure results against plant KPIs, and scale what works
* Keep Oracle EBS and shop floor data accurate enough for AI tools to use
* Comply and follow all procedures within the company's IT security policy, including the use of AI tools and protection of customer data and drawings
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

**KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong commitment to Crenlo Operating System to drive continuous improvement
 + Strategy Deployment: Break through objectives, action plans, metrics, countermeasures
 + Gemba: shop floor metrics, Gemba walks, interaction with operators to solve problems, action items and follow-up
 + Daily Management: 9:00 meeting every day, what was expected, what did we achieve, what went wrong, what actions are required to restore flow and solve to root
 + KPIs with Countermeasures: Key Performance Indicators. When commitments missed drive countermeasures for root cause corrective actions using data
* Use metrics to drive the business (Data, Paretos, 80/20 approach, visual management)
* Strong understanding and ownership of materials management
 + Capacity Planning
 + Material Flow
 + Inventory Accuracy / Cycle Counting
 + Understanding of how to leverage ERP / MRP
* Attention to detail
* Sense of urgency / bias to action / meets commitments without reminders
* Holds teams accountable (Role clarity, measure and follow-up, rewards and consequences), True owner for every process and metric
* Lead from the front: clearly in charge, strong communications, sets priorities, measures performance
* Doer vs. pure delegator
* Comfortable making decisions
* In depth knowledge of OEM and or component manufacturing with an emphasis on steel processing and cab/auto manufacturing
* Keen knowledge of ISO 9001 and QMS (quality management systems)
* Experienced in using the following software packages: Oracle EBS, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Microsoft Project, Power BI, AI assistants (e.g., Claude)
* Hands-on user of AI tools in daily work who sets the example for the staff
* Spots repetitive work and turns it into an AI or automation project
* Working knowledge of vision systems, sensors, and robotic and cobot welding
* Brings operators and supervisors along on new technology, positioning AI as a tool that helps them do their jobs
* Ability to build and leverage partnerships, implement change, and manage projects
* Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community
* Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors
* Strong knowledge of global and regional logistics operations and industry
* Strong ability in determining logistics requirements to enable company's business goals and objectives with ability to devise and implement strategy to achieve targets
* Strong financial and analytical ability with proficiency in managing business analytics to determine optimum company footprint
* Proven track record of successful change management accomplishments, implementing and management continuous productivity and cost reduction programs
* Strong and convincing communication skills both verbally and written

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required preferably in Engineering
* Minimum 6-10 years' experience in an operations leadership role with a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role, with direct P&L responsibility, mainly in a manufacturing environment
* Minimum 5 years previous experience managing in a manufacturing environment, preferably in OEM
* Manufacturing management experience should reflect understanding of the impact factory performance has in the areas of delivery, cost, quality, and service
* Previous experience with price structuring and job costing
* Preferred: experience leading an automation, vision, or digital project in a manufacturing plant with measured results
* Or a combination of education, experience and/or training

**WORKING CONDITIONS/OTHER:**

* Work Hours/Status:
* Travel Requirements:
* Environment:
* Physical Requirements statement(s):
* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal and state employment law, compliance, trends, new technologies and best practices in areas of responsibilities.

*This position description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and competencies required of this position. Employees are held accountable for all aspects for the job, which are subject to change at any time. An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

records.title: Strategic Account Director - Manufacturing
records.description:
**Description:**
================

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

**Position Summary:**
=====================

As a Manufacturing Strategic Account Director, you will work with manufacturers and brands of all sizes (with focus on mid-market and enterprise organizations from $70M - $1B+ in annual revenue) to automate the exchange of crucial supply chain data and drive/manage change with their supplier community. The role will focus on working with current Manufacturing subscribers of SPS Relationship Management to expand and grow the partnership through upsell and cross-sell. This is a quota-carrying, fast-paced role for a critical thinker who communicates with confidence and presence, stays organized across a large territory, and collaborates well with others. 
 

This is a quota-carrying, fast-paced role for a critical thinker who communicates with confidence, stays organized across a large territory, and collaborates well with others.

### **What You'll Do**

* Learn and apply the Relationship Management for Manufacturing go-to-market methodology, adapting as the content evolves.
* Run a value-based sales process and manage a defined territory, from identifying and developing opportunities through close.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for current Manufacturing customers, driving growth through: Additional phases of supplier onboarding across supplier segments, order types, and shipping models Product add-ons such as Visibility Management Maximizing Ongoing Supplier Onboarding where applicable
* Assess each customer's situation, priorities, and stakeholders, then choose and sequence the right sales tools, resources, and SPS partners to move the opportunity forward.
* Manage contractual events such as scope increases and decreases.
* Work closely with SPS account teams to align on customer details and account strategy, share key information openly, and build support for customer success.
* Maintain a rolling 90-day pipeline to meet or exceed your ARR quota.
* Partner with the Strategic Account Executive aligned to your territory as new customers transition to your ownership, and on an ongoing basis as needed.
* Keep customers satisfied by responding promptly and ensuring strong alignment with Customer Success.
Document findings, progress, insights, and pipeline velocity in Salesforce. 

 

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years of quota-carrying sales, **or** some post-secondary education and 9+ years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience managing the full sales cycle: prospecting, building pipeline, handling objections, demonstrating ROI, forecasting accurately, and staying persistent through both short and long cycles.
* Clear, concise, confident communication (verbal, non-verbal, and written), including strong listening skills and the ability to adjust tone to the audience.
* The ability to explain business and technical topics to audiences with varied expertise, and to navigate customer organizations to reach the right stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with product management, support, sales leadership, and senior management.
* Demonstrated integrity, relationship building, and leadership.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SPS Retail/Community or selling SPS System Automation, including selling to the C-suite across functions such as Merchandising, E-Commerce, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, and Finance.
* A track record of building and sustaining executive-level customer relationships.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Salesforce, and a willingness to adopt AI tools such as Claude and CHAMP as they become available.

**Location:** Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid). We are not currently open to candidates who are not local to Minneapolis, MN.

 

### **What We Offer**

**Total annualized on-target compensation: $170,000.** Compensation reflects each employee's experience, performance, and skills. The range for this role considers factors such as education, relevant skills, work history, certifications, and location.

 

Our benefits include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; paid time off; a 401(k); health and flexible spending accounts; an employee stock purchase plan; and more.

 

### **Our Commitment to Employees**

At SPS, we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward. Our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering outstanding customer solutions, and driving business performance. We do that by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging, and where everyone is accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

 

We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

records.title: Business Development Director (Industrial / Advanced Manufacturing)
records.description:
Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri with more than 1,200 employees and nearing $2B in revenue, Alberici is a diversified construction company that partners with leading organizations throughout North America to build their most challenging and important projects.

Since our founding in 1918, Alberici earned a reputation for executing with quality, safety and trust. Combined with our 100+ years of experience, we provide construction solutions to the automotive, commercial, civil, energy, food & beverage, healthcare, heavy industrial, industrial process, and water industries.

***We build the critical structures that improve lives and strengthen communities.***

Our mission is simple — and our approach to delivering on it is equally straightforward. We are as open and honest with our employees and partners as we are with our clients. We are here to work together to do the best work possible to bring this mission to life.

When it comes to our team, Alberici employees are built differently. We seek the best and brightest and are committed to investing in our people and providing the training and resources they need to learn, grow, and advance. 
 
Are you **Built for the Challenge**?

**Our Values:**

* Working Safely
* Valuing Diversity
* Serving Humbly
* Executing with Integrity
* Solving Creatively
* Engaging Fully

**What We Offer:**

* Profit-sharing plan, cash bonus programs and annual cost-of-living adjustments
* Generous salary increases and per diems for qualified out-of-town assignments
* Health, dental and vision insurance eligibility on day one
* Paid parental leave
* Continuing education reimbursement
* Personalized career development and training programs
* Minimum of 29 days of PTO (including holidays) for entry-level roles
* Fitness center for St. Louis office-based team members
* Gym membership reimbursement for project-based team members
* Corporate office cafeteria access
* Employee Resource Group (ERG) opportunities
* Philanthropy opportunities

*Position Overview:*

The Business Development Director (Industrial / Advanced Manufacturing) is responsible for identifying, originating, and developing qualified business opportunities that expand Alberici’s market presence and support strategic growth throughout North America. This role focuses on identifying prospective clients and emerging capital projects, establishing relationships with senior decision makers, and leveraging market intelligence and professional networks to create new business opportunities.

The Business Development Director partners with Market Leadership, Project Development, and technical experts to understand client needs, position Alberici’s capabilities, and convert early-stage opportunities into qualified pursuits. This role is instrumental in expanding strategic client relationships, creating access to new markets, and supporting Alberici’s long-term growth objectives.

*Market Intelligence & Prospecting*

* Develops and executes strategic business development plans aligned with Alberici's growth objectives, identifying targeted clients, markets, geographies, and emerging opportunities.
* Proactively identifies capital investment programs and project opportunities early in development, leveraging industry relationships, market intelligence, research, and professional networks.
* Monitors industry trends, capital spending, competitive activity, and market developments to identify opportunities and determine effective strategies for early client engagement.
* Develops and maintains relationships with industry organizations, consultants, engineers, suppliers, and other strategic contacts to expand market intelligence, client access, and business opportunities

*Executive Relationship Development*

* Develops and maintains strategic relationships with senior executives, key decision makers, and influencers within targeted client organizations to expand Alberici's market presence and access to new business opportunities.
* Leverages professional networks and industry relationships to establish connections with prospective clients, navigate complex organizations, and strengthen long-term relationships.
* Develops a thorough understanding of prospective clients' business objectives, capital investment priorities, organizational structures, and decision-making processes to identify opportunities for meaningful engagement.
* Creates opportunities for Alberici's Market Leadership and technical experts to engage with prospective clients, effectively communicating the Company's capabilities, experience, and value proposition.

*Opportunity Development & Qualification*

* Converts market intelligence and strategic relationships into qualified business opportunities aligned with Alberici's capabilities, target markets, growth objectives, and risk profile.
* Evaluates prospective opportunities by assessing client business drivers, capital plans, project objectives, decision-making processes, competitive dynamics, and anticipated project timelines.
* Partners with Market Leadership to assess opportunity viability, establish engagement priorities, and determine which opportunities warrant further investment of Company resources.
* Maintains accurate and current information regarding client relationships, market intelligence, and business opportunities within the Company's business development tracking systems.
* Maintains accurate and timely documentation of client relationships, business development activities, qualified opportunities, and strategic engagement plans within Alberici's CRM system (AEC 360), ensuring visibility and accountability across the organization.
* Develops and maintains business development pipelines, opportunity forecasts, and weekly and monthly progress reports, tracking prospective clients, relationship development activities, anticipated opportunities, and planned actions to support strategic planning and growth objectives.

*Internal Engagement & Handoff*

* Identifies the appropriate timing to engage Market Leadership, Project Development, and technical experts in qualified opportunities, facilitating meaningful introductions and client engagement.
* Provides internal teams with relevant client intelligence, business objectives, decision-making dynamics, and competitive insights to support effective positioning and pursuit strategies.
* Partners with Market Leadership and Project Development to ensure a coordinated transition from opportunity development to active pursuit, maintaining continuity in client relationships and strategic positioning.
* Remains engaged as a relationship resource throughout the pursuit process, collaborating across Alberici's markets and operating groups while supporting the appropriate leaders responsible for project solutions and pursuit execution.
* Collaborates with Marketing, Market Leadership, and Project Development throughout the pursuit and proposal process, providing client intelligence and insights into key priorities, challenges, and decision criteria to support effective positioning, messaging, and proposal development.

*Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree within engineering, construction management, marketing or other relevant fields
* Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a business development role within construction, engineering, architecture, or sales
* Proven track record of client and sales acquisition with established relationships in the sectors of advanced manufacturing, defense, aerospace, and/or process manufacturing
* **Must be willing to travel as required**

**Growth Opportunities**

Alberici invests heavily in our team members training and development in both technical, management, and leadership aptitude.

This role is on the business development career ladder; employees participate in a Professional Development Plan (PDP) focused on career advancement.

Typical growth opportunities for this position include:

* Senior Business Development Director, followed by Vice President of Business Development

*Alberici is a North American company with multiple Operating Companies:*

*Alberici Constructors, Inc., Alberici Constructors, LTD., Alberici Construcciones, BRC,* *CAS Constructors, Filanc, Flintco, Hillsdale Fabricators, and Kienlen Constructors*

records.title: Director, Dental Furniture Operations
records.description:
At A-dec, we do more than create the highest quality products and services for the dental industry; we strive to deliver a superior employment experience for each of our team members. With an environment that encourages and assists each person in developing to their highest potential, a career at A-dec is incredibly rewarding.

**Overview**
------------

The Director, Dental Furniture Operations provides strategic direction and end-to-end operational oversight for A-dec’s dental furniture value stream at the Newberg campus. The role leads manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning for the value stream and is accountable for delivering the dental furniture business plan, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity growth. The Director partners with product line leadership and functions across Manufacturing and the enterprise to translate product and demand plans into a scalable, high-mix, engineered-to-order operation, while strengthening woodworking capability and continuous improvement.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* End-to-end performance of the Dental Furniture value stream: safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, and inventory against the business plan.
* Dental Furniture purchasing and production and materials planning, including supplier performance, material availability, and inventory levels.
* Capacity, workforce, equipment, and space plans that support Dental Furniture growth and new product introductions.
* Leadership bench strength and succession for all managers and critical roles in assigned areas.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead the managers responsible for manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning. Define the area’s operating system, including standards, tiered performance reviews, and escalation paths, and hold managers accountable for meeting customer and company safety, quality, delivery, and cost standards.
* Develop annual business plans and budgets, including key performance indicators; assess current capacity and capability and establish multi-year plans for workforce, equipment, space, and investment to meet forecasted demand and support growth; prepare business cases for capital and expense needs.
* Set direction for Dental Furniture manufacturing engineering, including process technology, automation, and capital project priorities that improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost and strengthen woodworking capability.
* Own purchasing and production and materials planning for the Dental Furniture line, including supplier selection and performance, material availability, and inventory targets; operate within enterprise purchasing policies, partner with Global Sourcing on commodity strategy and shared suppliers, and represent the value stream in the enterprise SIOP process.
* Partner with product line leadership, Product Development, and Marketing to translate product strategy, roadmap, and pricing into executable operational initiatives and support the transition of new products into production.
* Set annual targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and efficiency; own results and lead monthly operating reviews with managers to set priorities and drive systemic corrective action.
* Lead deployment of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement across assigned areas; set and prioritize the improvement portfolio against the business plan and build a culture of creative problem solving, collaboration, learning, and development.
* Ensure operations within assigned areas comply with company safety, regulatory, and quality policies and applicable environmental requirements; partner with Environmental Health and Safety, Quality, and other functions to address risks and sustain compliance.
* Set performance objectives for direct reports, review results, and hold them accountable for achieving annual business objectives; take appropriate corrective action when needed.
* + Own workforce strategy for assigned areas: with managers, assess capabilities, close skill and staffing gaps, and plan labor against forecasted demand. Develop managers and maintain succession plans for critical roles.
 + Partner with People & Culture to lead organizational design, change management, and employee engagement; promote a respectful, inclusive, and people-focused work environment.
 + Partner with the Director, Manufacturing Operations – Machining & Maintenance on machined-component supply, maintenance service levels, and equipment reliability, and with other Manufacturing leaders on shared capabilities and capital priorities that support Dental Furniture operations.
 + Communicate value-stream priorities, performance, risks, and resource needs to executive leadership, peers, and employees.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to lead managers across manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including high-mix, engineered-to-order production and woodworking or related manufacturing processes.
* Ability to develop and execute business plans, budgets, capacity strategies, and capital priorities aligned with product and business goals.
* Understanding of manufacturing engineering, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Ability to interpret operational and financial data and use performance measures to guide decisions that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity.
* Effective communication, relationship-building, and change leadership skills, including the ability to work across product line leadership, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a changing manufacturing environment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing or operations leadership, including at least four years in a senior leadership role.
* Experience leading production planning, materials planning, and purchasing, with accountability for inventory, supplier performance, and SIOP participation.
* Experience leading lean manufacturing and continuous improvement deployment.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and coordinating multiple functions within a manufacturing value stream.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, engineering, operations, or a related field.
* Experience in furniture, woodworking, high-mix, engineered-to-order, or medical device manufacturing.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certification.

**Physical Requirements:**

Ability to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise maneuver up to 35 pounds with or without assistance on a routine basis. Must have manual hand dexterity to grasp, operate tools and equipment repetitively. Able to walk, stand, sit, bend, reach, and occasionally kneel, climb steps, and twist throughout an entire shift. Some areas may be exposed to chemicals, noise, vibration and /or dust, and require the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE); such as, but not limited to safety glasses, hearing protection, foot protection, etc.

**Disclaimer**

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not to be construed as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. A-dec reserves the right to assign job duties and days and hours of work based on factors such as workload requirements, staffing levels, and customer demands.

At A-dec, we value our people and show it by prioritizing an inclusive culture, total well-being, and opportunities for learning and career advancement.

**A background check and screen for the illegal use of drugs is required.** 
 
*A-dec is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, A-dec will not discriminate against applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another. \*VEVRAA Federal Contractor”*

*A-dec is interested in qualified candidates authorized to work in the United States for US-based positions. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.*
