records.description:
Description:

**MAC Medical** is known for having a team culture that works together and inspires us to be better! We are a family owned and operated business founded in 1998 which builds American made medical equipment.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Manager is responsible for overseeing all daily manufacturing operations within the facility, including production, fabrication, welding, polishing, assembly, material handling, scheduling, and shipping.

This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure production goals are achieved, customer requirements are met, resources are effectively utilized, employees are properly trained, and manufacturing processes operate safely and efficiently.

The Plant Manager is responsible for establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, employee development, operational discipline, and cross-departmental collaboration while supporting the company's business objectives, quality standards, and customer commitments.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Oversee all daily manufacturing operations, including stainless steel fabrication, welding, polishing, assembly, material handling, and shipping.
* Manage production schedules, staffing, workflow, and resources to meet customer demands and delivery commitments.
* Lead, develop, and hold supervisors, team leaders, and manufacturing personnel accountable for performance and operational goals.
* Monitor production efficiency, labor utilization, quality, scrap, rework, downtime, and operational costs.
* Identify operational challenges and implement process improvements to increase productivity, reduce waste, and improve efficiency.
* Ensure products meet established specifications, quality standards, customer requirements, and applicable ISO procedures.
* Promote a safe working environment and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company safety policies, and PPE requirements.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, Purchasing, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Human Resources to support manufacturing operations.
* Oversee equipment maintenance, inventory availability, and production resources to minimize disruptions and downtime.
* Support employee training, performance management, coaching, corrective action, and workforce development.
* Implement lean manufacturing, 5S, continuous improvement, and operational accountability initiatives.
* Communicate production performance, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities to executive leadership.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Strong knowledge of stainless-steel fabrication and manufacturing processes, including welding, polishing, forming, cutting, and assembly.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, manufacturing drawings, specifications, and work instructions.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, workflow management, quality systems, inventory control, and manufacturing operations.
* Understanding of ISO standards, safety regulations, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement principles.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, decision-making, and employee development skills.
* Ability to establish expectations, manage performance, and hold employees accountable.
* Ability to analyze production data, identify inefficiencies, and implement improvements.
* Proficiency with manufacturing systems, ERP software, and Microsoft Office.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY**

This position has direct supervisory responsibility for manufacturing personnel.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

This position operates primarily within a stainless-steel manufacturing facility and is regularly exposed to manufacturing equipment, machinery, welding operations, metal fabrication processes, polishing operations, noise, heat, dust, airborne particles, moving equipment, and industrial traffic. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) and adherence to all company safety policies and procedures are required.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Ability to stand and walk throughout the manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to navigate manufacturing floors, production areas, warehouse areas, and workstations.
* Ability to bend, stoop, reach, climb stairs, and perform occasional physical tasks as necessary.
* Ability to lift up to 50 pounds occasionally, if required.
* Ability to work on concrete surfaces for extended periods.
* Ability to maintain awareness of machinery, forklifts, equipment, welding operations, and other workplace hazards.
* Ability to wear required PPE.
* Must maintain safe work practices and ensure compliance with applicable safety requirements.

**POSITION TYPE / EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK**

This is a full-time exempt position. The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a schedule necessary to effectively oversee manufacturing operations and support business needs. Standard work hours may vary based on production schedules, staffing, operational demands, and management requirements. Occasional evening, weekend, or extended hours may be required.

Health insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

Life insurance

Short-term disability

Long-term disability

Paid time off

Paid holidays

Employee assistance program

records.title: Director of Plant Operations - Full Time
records.description:
Description:

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Plant Operations Director works in cooperation with the Directors/Supervisors to coordinate the safety and maintenance and equipment needs of owned and leased facilities in which services are provided.

* Full Time - First Shift, Monday - Friday
* Some after-hours/on-call
* Salaried, exempt

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Associate's Degree in Industrial Maintenance or related field preferred.
* Two (2) years' experience in all phases of building maintenance.
* Experience in estimating maintenance and repair costs is considered an asset.
* Previous management experience preferred.

**ORGANIZATIONAL EXPECTATIONS**

* Provides a positive and professional representation of the organization.
* Promotes culture of safety for patients and employees through proper identification, reporting, documentation, and prevention.
* Maintains hospital standards for a clean and quiet patient environment to maintain a positive patient care experience.
* Maintains competency and knowledge of current standards of practice, trends, and developments in related scope of job role or practice.
* Adheres to infection-control policies and protocols and storage procedures.
* Participates in ongoing quality improvement activities.
* Maintains compliance with organization’s policies, as well as established practices, protocols, and procedures of the position, department, and applicable professional standards.
* Complies with organizational and regulatory policies for handling confidential patient information.
* Demonstrates excellent customer service through his/her attitude and actions, consistent with the standards contained in the Vision, Mission, and Values of the organization.
* Adheres to professional standards, hospital policies and procedures, federal, state, and local requirements, and DNV standards and/or standards from other accrediting bodies.

**Standards of Behavior** Adheres to the standards of behavior (ownership, integrity, professionalism, teammate, service excellence, and communication).

**Five Fundamentals of Service** Adheres to the five fundamentals of service (acknowledgement, introduction, duration, explanation, and thank you) to promote quality customer service.

**Service Recovery** Demonstrates a commitment to the service recovery CARE approach (Connect, Apologize, Repair, and Exceed).

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Site safety — The Plant Operations Director ensures that high standards of safety are developed, met, and maintained.**

* Arranges and coordinates annual fire safety inspections with authorities having jurisdiction.
* Follows up on any deficiencies or recommendations.
* Arranges and coordinates the internal safety inspections of facilities conducted by certified safety professionals.
* Follows up on deficiencies and recommendations.
* Participates in the process and function of the hospital safety committee.

**Site maintenance — The Plant Operations Director ensures that the facility and grounds are maintained in accordance with relevant regulations, agency standards, and fiscal consideration.**

* Develops, implements, and reviews regularly site-specific maintenance logs for each services facility.
* Evaluates long-term needs in relation to major projects and property improvements and develops a five-year plan outlining same in cooperation with relevant consultants designated by the agency.
* Coordinates, arranges, and supervises or provides for the completion of corrective and preventive maintenance in accordance with agency operating procedures, practices, and financial considerations.
* Completion of work may involve one or more of the following resources, as directed by the President, contracted labor per bid, as relevant, services personnel, paid or volunteer workers or crews.

**Equipment maintenance — The Plant Operations Director ensures that major equipment and furnishings are maintained in safe, operable condition and/or arrange for replacement.**

* Develops, implements, and reviews equipment records (included in maintenance logs). Establishes procedures and contacts to ensure timely repairs of equipment requiring minor repairs on a frequent basis.
* Secures major equipment bids and makes recommendations for purchase when replacement or new equipment is required.

**Safety and maintenance training—The Plant Operations Director may arrange for or provide training for personnel as it relates to the safety and maintenance needs of the facility. Further, the Director may attend training programs relevant to the duties and responsibilities of this position.**

* Provides staff training in a variety of safety and maintenance topics including the effective utilization of the maintenance logs, completion of routine maintenance specific to the facility, equipment operations, multimedia fire safety training, and so forth.
* Arranges and coordinates annual fire safety training, Attends and participates in training opportunities and seminars relevant to this position.

**NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Participates in the development of policies and procedures related to maintenance and safety.
* Participates in annual budget preparation as it relates to maintenance and safety of the facility, grounds, and equipment.
* Serves as a member of other relevant agency committees as assigned.
* Ensures the appropriate use and proper care of the facility's maintenance vehicle. Completes other assignments as deemed appropriate by the President.

**LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES**

* Effective, credible, and engaging leader; able to motivate, influence, and hold team members accountable.
* Possesses skills and knowledge in the following areas: principles of organization, theories of management, human resources management, strategies of therapy management, financial management, and foundations of health laws.
* Visionary Leader - Displays passion and optimism; inspires respect and trust; mobilizes others to fulfill the vision; provides vision and inspiration to peers and subordinates.
* Exhibits confidence in self and others.
* Inspires and motivates other to perform well.
* Effectively influences actions and opinions of others.
* Accepts feedback from others.
* Gives appropriate recognition of others.

Requirements:

**FUNCTIONAL DEMANDS**

**Working Conditions and Physical Environment**

* Works in a patient care setting where there is potential exposure to blood, body fluids, infectious materials; and electrical, fire, chemical, physical contact and equipment hazards.
* Fast-paced setting with rapid patient turnover.
* High patient traffic.
* Close-quartered and shared work space.
* Sufficient mobility to negotiate physical plant.
* Strength and endurance sufficient enough to perform physically for long periods of time without sitting (four to eight hours). May include: walking; lifting 25 – 50lbs with or without assistance; bending; twisting; standing; sitting; reaching; stair-climbing and descending.
* Physical dexterity and psychomotor skills to respond adequately and appropriately to routine and emergency patient care needs in an ambulatory setting.
* Visual and auditory capabilities sufficient to read information and respond to patient care needs.
* Ability to work in a computerized environment that includes prolonged sitting and use of keyboard, mouse, and monitor.
* Cognitive ability to accurately observe, analyze, and interpret general and technical data both verbal and written to accurately communicate this information

records.description:
**Director of Operations, Maintenance, and Installation (OMI)**

Compensation: Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications

Job Type: Full-time, exempt

Location: Irvine, California, with regular site travel

**Benefits**

Health, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance; retirement savings plan; paid holidays; and PTO, subject to plan terms and eligibility.

**About N2W Engineering**

N2W Engineering provides engineering, construction, systems, and operations support for infrastructure clients, including water and wastewater. Our values are Trust, Integrity, Generosity, Efficiency, and Responsiveness.

**Position Overview**

Lead the overall management, financial performance, service delivery, and growth of N2W’s Operations, Maintenance, and Installation (OMI) business unit. The Director is accountable for a safe, compliant, reliable, and profitable portfolio of facilities, service contracts, and installation projects.

Reporting to N2W executive leadership, the Director leads the OMI management and field teams, establishes performance expectations, and develops business capabilities. The OMI Supervisor manages daily field activities, staffing, and routine operational issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Business unit management. Develop the annual business plan, operating budget, growth strategy, and performance targets. Manage business unit resources, priorities, and risks to achieve sustainable growth and profitability.
* Business development. Develop new and existing client opportunities, manage the sales pipeline, and lead scopes of work, estimates, pricing, proposals, and contract negotiations within delegated authority. Evaluate feasibility, staffing, risk, and target margins before pursuing work.
* Financial management. Own revenue, gross margin, and business unit profitability. Establish contract and project budgets, monitor actual costs and forecasts, control labor utilization, overtime, travel, purchasing, and subcontractor expenses, and implement corrective actions.
* Client and contract management. Lead client relationships, regular performance reviews, renewals, and issue resolution. Manage contractual obligations, scope changes, change orders, timely billing, and recovery of additional services.
* Operations and maintenance. Oversee facility performance, permit compliance, staffing coverage, service continuity, preventive and corrective maintenance, asset reliability, critical spares, and contract mobilization and transitions.
* Installation services. Oversee mechanical, electrical, and equipment installation projects, including planning, schedules, procurement, subcontractors, field execution, commissioning, quality, and budget performance.
* Safety and risk. Implement and enforce safety and environmental compliance programs, training, emergency preparedness, incident reporting, investigations, and corrective actions. Escalate significant risks promptly.
* Leadership and resource management. Lead and develop supervisors and field personnel. Manage staffing, hiring, resource allocation, productivity, succession planning, training, and employee performance in coordination with HR.
* Quality and internal coordination. Establish service, workmanship, documentation, and project control standards. Drive continuous improvement and collaborate with engineering, automation, and finance to deliver integrated services and identify cross-selling opportunities.

* Experience developing business opportunities, proposals, scopes, cost estimates, pricing, and managing service contracts and commercial risks.
* Strong knowledge of treatment operations, asset reliability, safety, environmental compliance, and emergency response; installation or construction management experience preferred.
* Strong leadership, communication, and technical and commercial judgment; proficiency with business, project, and maintenance management systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental science, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant leadership experience considered.
* Applicable California operator certification or professional credential preferred; any certified operator-in-charge duties require the credential mandated for that facility.
* Regular site travel, including Gilroy, Fullerton, and other locations; overnight travel and response to escalated emergencies outside normal hours as required.

Lead and grow an established business unit, develop its people, expand service offerings, and directly influence N2W’s strategic direction, client success, and profitability.

records.title: Plant Manager I
records.description:
**Job Details:**

At Tyson Foods, we believe that our team members are the heart of our success. Are you ready to take on a dynamic role where you can make a significant impact? Join Our Team in the Prepared Foods Division as a Plant Manager I!

 

**Setting the table for your success** :

At Tyson Foods, our team members’ health and wellness is very important to us. We believe in helping our team members thrive inside and outside of the workplace. That’s why we’re committed to providing a holistic benefits package that provides support for you and your family.

 

We invest in our team members and their success by providing resources like **BENEFITS ON DAY ONE OF EMPLOYMENT and FREE EDUCATION!**

 

Benefits include medical/Rx, dental, and vision coverage; 9 paid holidays; [4] weeks paid vacation upon hire, plus earned time off; 401(k) with employer match; stock purchase program; and product purchase program. We also offer **CAREER GROWTH** and much more!

 

Summary: This facility is part of our Prepared Foods business unit and manufactures cooked Philly Steak. Looking for a leader to fill the Plant Manager role for this well-established facility through significant changes to the overall business.

 

**RESPONSIBILITIES** :

* Leadership & Safety
* Be a safety leader at the plant, establishing and directing plant policies and procedures.
* Maintain a clean and safe working environment, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and company regulations.
* Establish and foster a team environment, promoting a positive culture.
* Operations & Production Management
* Direct and coordinate all plant operations and maintenance, adhering to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee and achieve plant production goals.
* Establish production schedules across all shifts to meet demand.
* Quality & Customer Relations
* Ensure product quality standards are met and maintained.
* Work directly with customers and suppliers to meet expectations and support operational needs.
* Staffing & Development
* Select, train, and manage plant supervisory and operations staff.
* Conduct employee performance reviews and support career development.
* Schedule and lead regular plant meetings to support communication and planning.
* Cross-Departmental Coordination
* Collaborate with department heads to coordinate safety, purchasing, production, quality, HR, accounting, and shipping.
* Community & Corporate Engagement
* Establish and maintain positive relationships within the community.
* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings.
Other Duties: Perform other duties as assigned. 

 

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Education: Associate or bachelor’s degree required.
* Experience: At least four years of plant management experience required to include progressive levels of responsibility. Direction of plant operations and supply chain knowledge helpful. Lean experience is preferred. Capital project management experience is preferred.
* Computer Skills: Good computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite.
* Communication Skills: Good verbal and written skills. Bilingual is preferred.
* Supervisory: Yes.
* Travel: 3 - 6 trips per year domestic and possible international trips.

All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes.

**Relocation Assistance Eligible:**

Yes

**Work Shift:**

1ST SHIFT (United States of America)

**Pay Range/Rate:**

$129,000.00 - $215,000.00

**Incentives:**

Annual Incentive Plan:

Yes

Long-Term Incentive Plan:

No

**Certain roles at Tyson require background checks. If you are offered a position that requires a background check you will be provided additional documentation to complete once an offer has been extended.**

Any listed amounts represent the base pay range. Additional compensation may be available for this position based on various factors such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonuses. Pay is just one part of Tyson’s total compensation package.

 
 

***Tyson will develop an offer based on a candidate's or team member’s relevant skills and capabilities, the market data for the role described in this requisition, internal equity, and other information relevant to the candidate and role.***

 

Hourly Applicants ONLY -You must complete the task after submitting your application to provide additional information to be considered for employment.

 
 

The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

 
 

Tyson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, national origin, color, religion, age, genetics, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Location:

Garden City, NY, US, 11530

Business Unit: Treitler FMH

Posting Date: Nov 20, 2026

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for leading Hughes-Treitler operations to achieve business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This hands-on leadership role provides strategic and day-to-day direction for manufacturing, materials, and operational excellence while ensuring the organization has the talent, capacity, processes, and resources required to support current demand and business growth. The Director establishes operating plans, drives accountability, builds organizational capability, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance, expand capacity, control costs, and strengthen customer responsiveness.

 

**Supervisory Responsibilties:**

The position has direct reports but must be able to work in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Production in support of the departmental objectives. 



**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop Operations teams to effectively support day-to-day execution, strategic business objectives, customer requirements, and growth plans.
* Establish operating strategies, objectives, budgets, capital requirements, material plans, labor requirements, and organizational priorities aligned with customer and business needs.
* Ensure the organization is structured and staffed with the talent, resources, and capabilities needed to meet customer quality, technical, delivery, and turnaround-time expectations.
* Partner with business leadership to achieve key performance indicators, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, throughput, backlog reduction, customer lead time, productivity, labor utilization, cost, and profitability.
* Lead the development and execution of the site Lean and Operational Excellence roadmap, using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, TPM, SIOP and daily management practices to improve flow, yield, cycle time, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and monitor operating standards, performance metrics, and management routines that drive accountability, timely problem-solving, and sustained results.
* Drive capacity planning and expansion initiatives, including capital equipment, automation, facility, tooling, staffing, and process investments required to support business growth.
* Manage operating expenses and capital investments in accordance with approved budgets; identify and execute cost-reduction and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure effective planning and control of materials, inventory, suppliers, production schedules, and labor resources to support quality, cost, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to resolve operational issues, support new product introductions, strengthen manufacturability, and meet customer requirements.
* Provide leadership for robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer performance.
* Participate in the development and execution of the business strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable operating plans and measurable objectives.
* Support commercial and customer-facing activities, including operational reviews, pricing and capacity analyses, customer visits, and performance presentations.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain operations talent through performance management, career development, succession planning, cross-training, and ongoing capability building.
* Foster a culture of accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Author annual performance reviews and develop continuing education and advancement paths for entire department.
* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost performance, including identifying suitable use cases and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs.
 

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to establish performance metrics, analyze operating data, prioritize competing demands, and drive accountability for results.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective work relationships.
* Strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to balance customer requirements with operational, financial, and organizational priorities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a hands-on leadership presence across the operation.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and manufacturing systems; experience with SIOP or related planning processes preferred.
* Demonstrated history of successful change management and implementation of operational excellence improvements.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization from the production floor to the executive office.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed to support business requirements.
 

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or another related technical discipline required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience in a low-volume/high-mix, build-to-order, or engineered-products environment; experience in aerospace, defense, metal-forming, precision machining, brazing, welding, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading salaried and hourly employees.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement programs with measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational planning, capital and capacity expansion, production and materials management, cost optimization, organizational improvements, and customer-facing operational reviews.

**Other:**

* Due to the nature of Hughes-Treitler's programs and products, applicants must have the legal right to work in the US and additionally must be legally authorized to access export-controlled information and source code.

records.title: Sr. Director of Quality
records.description:
The Senior Director of Quality is responsible for leading quality, regulatory compliance, and functions at an assigned facility while providing strategic leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments across multiple FCAH locations and operating companies. This role ensures compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, customer, and industry requirements while driving consistency in quality standards, processes, audit readiness, corrective actions, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Senior Director serves as a hands-on quality leader at their assigned location while partnering with site leadership and other Quality leaders to strengthen quality systems, address regulatory and operational risks, develop quality teams, and promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across the organization.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Site Quality Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Quality department at the assigned facility, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Partner with site leadership, Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other departments to integrate quality into daily operations and decision-making.
* Oversee site quality personnel, including staffing, performance management, training, development, and accountability.
* Ensure the facility maintains required certifications, approvals, manuals, procedures, and quality systems.
* Monitor site quality performance, identify areas of risk, and develop action plans to address deficiencies and improve operational performance.

**Multi-Site Quality Leadership & Support**

* Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments and leaders across other First Class Air operating companies and locations.
* Partner with site Quality leaders to identify challenges, strengthen quality processes, and improve regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Promote consistency in quality standards, processes, procedures, and best practices across locations where appropriate.
* Assist other locations with quality initiatives, regulatory concerns, audit preparation, corrective actions, customer issues, and process improvement efforts.
* Conduct site visits to evaluate quality systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide support to local Quality teams.
* Share lessons learned, recurring quality issues, and best practices across locations to prevent repeat findings and improve overall organizational performance.
* Help develop and implement company-wide quality initiatives while allowing for site-specific requirements, certifications, and regulatory differences.
* Escalate significant regulatory, operational, customer, or quality risks to executive leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Oversight**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, , customer, and other regulatory requirements, as applicable to company operations.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, including Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Serve as a point of contact for regulatory authorities, customer representatives, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure applicable requirements are communicated and implemented across affected locations.
* Ensure maintenance, repair, overhaul, inspection, manufacturing, and other applicable activities are performed in accordance with approved technical data, regulatory requirements, and established procedures.
* Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) at the assigned location and across other locations as needed.
* Establish and promote consistent quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization.
* Oversee the development, revision, and implementation of quality manuals, procedures, inspection programs, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate document control, records management, inspection processes, calibration programs, personnel qualifications, training, and other critical quality system controls are maintained.
* Partner with site and enterprise leadership to improve quality processes, reduce risk, and enhance operational performance.

**Audits, Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and oversee internal, external, regulatory, customer, and third-party audits at the assigned facility.
* Support and provide guidance to other locations in preparation for and execution of audits.
* Develop and support risk-based audit schedules and audit strategies.
* Ensure audit findings and quality issues are appropriately investigated, contained, corrected, and documented.
* Oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes and ensure root cause analysis is appropriately performed.
* Verify corrective actions are effective and prevent recurring issues.
* Identify recurring findings, systemic quality issues, and trends across locations and implement improvements where appropriate.

**Airworthiness & Technical Quality**

* Provide oversight of airworthiness and return-to-service processes across applicable repair station operations.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, inspection, certification, and related airworthiness documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure receiving, in-process, and final inspections are performed in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
* Oversee the management and control of capability lists, personnel authorizations, technician and inspector qualifications, stamps, and related records.
* Ensure calibration programs and control of tools, equipment, and test instruments meet applicable requirements.
* Assist other locations with technical quality concerns, inspection processes, airworthiness issues, and regulatory interpretations as needed.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Provide leadership and support in resolving significant customer quality concerns, escalations, and recurring issues.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure customer quality expectations are understood and met.
* Monitor supplier-related quality trends and recurring issues.
* Support supplier corrective actions, quality investigations, and improvement initiatives as needed.
* Serve as a quality escalation resource for customer and supplier issues across locations.

**Quality Performance, Reporting & Risk Management**

* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, KPIs, trends, and reporting processes for the assigned facility.
* Support the development and implementation of company-wide quality dashboards and performance metrics.
* Evaluate quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate significant quality concerns, regulatory risks, audit findings, and improvement initiatives to site leadership and executive leadership.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize quality initiatives and allocate resources appropriately.
* Provide visibility into quality performance across locations and recommend actions to improve overall company performance.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in aviation, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Compliance,, Inspection, or related functions preferred.
* Significant experience leading Quality functions within aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, manufacturing, or FAA-certified repair station environments.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience working directly with FAA, EASA, UK CAA, customer representatives, or other regulatory authorities preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, customer, internal, and external audits.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining Quality Management Systems.
* Strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, particularly Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Knowledge of EASA, UK CAA,, and other applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause analysis, risk management, audit processes, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret technical data, regulatory requirements, manuals, procedures, engineering documentation, and quality standards.
* This role will require 20%-30% travel to other facilities

records.title: EW Operations Engineering Director
records.description:
**Job Description** 
We are seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished EW Operations Engineering Director with strong Hardware, Systems, and RF design experience, to bridge the gap between advance systems development and factory production. This executive-level role requires a deeply experienced leader who understands product requirements and performance to oversee the complete Life Cycle Management (LCM) of complex hardware ensuring that highly sophisticated Digital and RF Designs seamlessly transition from design environments into full scale production.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in Electronic Warfare (EW) systems and acts as the ultimate authority and liaison between Systems/Hardware Designs engineering and Manufacturing Operations. You will champion “Left Shift” engineering philosophies-refining, shaping, and validating hardware configurations long before they reach the factory floor to optimize, yield, efficiency, and electrical and mechanical compliances
 
•**Key Responsibilities**
 
•**Strategic Operations and Factory Leadership**
 
•Production Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end process governing how critical hardware is moved, staged, and executes across factories of record.
 
•Factory of record integration: Maintain comprehensive understanding of the People, Build, Equipment limitations, Operational Rules and technical boundaries to align design tolerances with factory capabilities.
 
•Operational Compliance: Author, Develop, and Maintain the Manufacturing Design Rules Documents in collaboration with the process engineers and subject matter experts (SME). Establish robust mitigation strategies for Non-compliant or ‘Red” technical requirements
 
•Technology Insertion: Evaluate, introduce, and integrate new manufacturing and test technologies and evolving factory capabilities to continually improve product lines.
 
•**Cross-Functional Engineering Liaison & Governance**
 
•Design-to-Production: Acts as the strategic liaison between Systems/HW Design and Operations “Enforcing” high standard and quality for manufacturing readiness and knowing precisely when to push back on design elements that challenge manufacturability
 
•Change Control & Audits : Represent Operations by attending and activity presenting Manufacturability requirements at the Engineering Leadership CARBs (Change/Configuration Action review Boards)
 
•Compliance & Technical Reviews: Demonstrate, Organize and Execute Systems/HW programs reviews including CCB (Change Control Boards) and PRB (Program Review Boards) to mitigate electrical compliance
 
•Left Shift & Process Optimization: Drive early-Stage engagement through the P2L/NPI processes to shape, refine and mature hardware layouts prior to factory entry
 
•**Test Engineering Strategy and Operations Engagement**
 
•Production test architecture: Oversee and understand the vision and long-term production test strategy, ensuring test development frameworks are fully integrated with operations,
 
•Design-for-Test (DFT): Partner directly with Hardware Design and test development engineering to enforce strict Production Test requirements and enforcing the Operations Test Rules 
 
 
 
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

•Education: Bachelors or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Operations or a closely related technical discipline

•Experience Level: Minimum of 20+ years of dedicated System/HW designs and Engineering/Operational Leadership with complex digital and high-frequency RF hardware domain

•Domain Expertise: Technical proficiency of electronic warfare (EW) systems. Including an expert-level understanding of how the hardware behaves internally and externally under operating conditions. Understanding critical System Tradeoffs in electrical performance.

•LCM Mastery: Documented success reshaping the Life-Cycle Management (LCM) paradigms, establishing “Left-Shift” framework and streamlining product handoffs to manufacturing

•Governance: Extensive background running rigorous technical reviews, electrical compliance boards, CCBs and PRBs

 
 
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

•Cross Discipline Mobilization: Lead, Mentor and rally multi-discipline, cross-functional engineering and operational teams to achieve swift pragmatic solutions (Driving to high confidence \*80% rule)

Trend Analysis & Optimizations: Partner with the program engineering groups to monitor production trends, identify anomalies, isolate hardware failure modes, and making data driven discissions )
 
 
**Pay Information**
 
Full-Time Salary Range: $173023 - $294137
 
 
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
 
 
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. 
 
 
 
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
 
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
 
 
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
 
 
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

records.title: Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)** 
 **OR**
* **Remote in United States**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $187,600 - $257,950, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com**. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

records.title: Senior Manager, Production
records.description:
**#ChangeMakers**

**Ready to make an impact?**

We develop, manufacture, and supply dental implants, clear aligners, instruments, CADCAM prosthetics and biomaterials for use in esthetic dentistry, tooth replacement and restoration solutions or to prevent tooth loss. 
 
We empower our employees to perform and make an impact, to question the status quo, to drive change, to stay ahead of the competition. From the first Dental Implant in 1974 to the latest Digital Solution – we do things differently than others 
 
We deliver innovation based on evidence. This is part of our employer culture as well as an exceptional team spirit that truly encourages diversity and a powerful “can-do” attitude.

**#WeChangeDentistry** every day. Be part of it.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking an inspiring and hands-on Production Manager to lead our make-to-order manufacturing organization. The successful candidate will build and develop a high-performing Production organization through visible shopfloor leadership, people development, Lean management, and operational excellence. 
This role is expected to create a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration while delivering outstanding performance in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People. 
The ideal candidate is a pragmatic leader who enjoys spending time on the shopfloor, develops people, and builds sustainable management systems rather than relying on short-term solutions.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

Leadership & People 

* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing Production organization.
* Develop shift leaders, supervisors, and frontline leaders through structured coaching, mentoring, feedback, and capability-building initiatives that strengthen leadership effectiveness and organizational readiness.
* Create an engaging, inclusive, and performance-oriented work environment that promotes ownership, teamwork, respect, continuous learning, and employee retention..
* Maintain a strong and visible presence on the manufacturing floor, leading through observation, engagement, coaching, and real-time problem solving while reinforcing safety, quality, and performance standards.
* Build a sustainable leadership pipeline within the Production organization.
* Lead complex operational problem solving through structured root-cause analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
* Foster a culture of accountability by establishing performance expectations, monitoring results, addressing performance gaps, and recognizing achievement.

**Operational Excellence** 

* Lead daily Production operations to consistently achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People objectives.
* Deploy and sustain Lean Daily Management, including Tier Meetings, Gemba Walks, Visual Management, and Leader Standard Work.
* Drive sustainable improvements in OTIF, OEE, productivity, quality, and scrap reduction.
* Use KPIs and structured problem solving to continuously improve operational performance.
* Build robust production systems that support long-term operational excellence.

**Operational Transformation**

* Lead manufacturing transformation initiatives that improve organizational capability and operational performance.
* Support industrialization projects and new manufacturing technologies.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement utilizing Lean manufacturing principles, employee engagement, and data-driven problem solving to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.
* Simplify workflows while increasing flexibility, efficiency, and employee engagement.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong partnerships with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other support functions.
* Promote proactive communication, transparency, and shared accountability across departments.
* Support new product introductions, process improvements, and strategic site initiatives.
* Act as a collaborative business partner supporting overall site performance.

**Operational Management**

* Define, monitor, and review KPIs related to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Productivity, and Employee Engagement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
* Optimize production resources while balancing customer expectations and operational priorities.
* Support budget achievement through productivity improvement and waste reduction initiatives.

**Management Responsibilities**

This position manages the following positions on a daily basis.

Direct management of Production Leaders.

Responsible for building an engaged, accountable, and high-performing Production organization.

**Physical Attributes****(If Applicable)**

* Production environment will include working with concentrated acid mixtures, Aluminum oxide blasting media, and medium pressure abrasive blasting equipment.
* Must be able to lift 50 lb without restrictions.
* Requires manual dexterity and ability to manipulate small objects.
* Must gain certification as an OSHA Hazmat First Responder within 12 months of job placement.
* Must be able to travel internationally

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading Production teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience developing frontline leaders and building high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational transformation initiatives.
* Practical Lean Manufacturing implementation experience.
* Experience working in a regulated manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Medical Device manufacturing.
* Experience in Aerospace, Pharmaceutical, Food, Automotive or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* CNC machining experience.
* Experience with ERP/MES systems.
* Lean Six Sigma certification (preferred but not required).

Salary: $120,000-135,000/Annually. *The final pay for this position will vary based on geographic location and candidate experience relative to what the company reasonably anticipates for this position.*

Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or brighten your SMILE, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

* Very Competitive total compensation plans (some positions include discretionary bonus, or Performance Share Units).
* A 401(K) plan to help you plan for your future with an employer match
* Great health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs to ensure you’re happy and healthy. Straumann contributes a healthy portion towards employees’ premium.
* Generous PTO allowance - plenty of time to recharge those batteries!

Please understand that we do not need external support by recruiting agencies and consultants to fill this vacancy. Thank you for respecting this.

**Videos To Watch**

https://youtu.be/3lq5BLAvIdQ

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

**Employment Type:** Full Time

**Alternative Locations:** United States : Mansfield (TX)

**Travel Percentage:** 0%

**Requisition ID:** 22548

records.title: Senior Manager, US Quality Operations
records.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

As production grows, we need clear evidence that each spacecraft meets its requirements and a quality system that helps teams find and resolve risks early.

We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Quality Operations** to lead US quality for satellite buses and payloads from incoming material through building, test and acceptance. You will build a pragmatic system and lead engineers and inspectors close to the floor. You have independent authority to hold work or withhold readiness concurrence and to escalate unresolved mission risk. This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

**What you will do:**
=====================

* Lead US quality engineers and inspectors across supplier, receiving, production and test coverage. Set training, inspection points and delegated authority.
* Own fit-for-stage quality controls for document and configuration records, serial and lot traceability, calibration, nonconformances, corrective action and acceptance packages.
* Define risk-based controls for critical characteristics and supplier parts. Work with Supply Chain on qualifications, escapes, containment and verified corrective action.
* Make quality status visible through yield, repeat defects, escapes, NCR aging and acceptance-record completeness. Use trends to improve controls with Manufacturing and Engineering.
* Own the quality hold and escalation process. Engineering owns technical disposition; Quality evaluates controls and evidence and concurs on release.
* Concur independently on quality evidence at acceptance and flight readiness reviews. Escalate residual risk despite schedule pressure; partner with Engineering on reliability and mission risk.
* Align common requirements with the Canada Quality Lead and feed ground defects and on-orbit anomalies into later builds.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 8+ years in quality engineering or quality management for aerospace, defense or similarly complex hardware, including 3+ years directly leading engineers, inspectors or specialists through production and test.
* Experience building a usable QMS and leading teams through supplier escapes, nonconformances, root cause and corrective action.
* Independent judgment, strong technical communication and the ability to separate Engineering disposition from Quality release concurrence.
* Working knowledge of configuration control, risk-based inspection, process capability and cross-functional investigations.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, materials science, physics or a related technical field, or equivalent quality leadership experience in complex hardware.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $180K - $230K

records.description:
**Job Description**

**General Summary**
-------------------

The Manufacturing Technical Services Senior Manager provides technical leadership for commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD) at external manufacturing partners. The role is accountable for overseeing technical services activities across the commercial manufacturing lifecycle, including manufacturing readiness, process performance, technical investigations, change management, process improvement, and supply-risk mitigation.

The Senior Manager partners with Manufacturing Operations, MS&T, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and CDMOs/CMOs to ensure manufacturing processes are robust, compliant, reliable, and capable of supporting product supply. The role leads complex cross-functional technical workstreams and develops technical talent within the Manufacturing Technical Services organization.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Lead Manufacturing Technical Services support for assigned commercial manufacturing programs and external manufacturing partners.
* Establish technical plans and priorities to support manufacturing readiness, commercial production campaigns, product supply, and lifecycle-management objectives.
* Provide technical oversight during manufacturing execution; lead escalation and resolution of complex process, equipment, yield, and manufacturing-performance issues.
* Lead technical investigations of significant manufacturing deviations, process excursions, yield loss, equipment failures, and product-quality events; ensure root cause, technical impact, and sustainable corrective actions are clearly defined.
* Oversee manufacturing, process, analytical, and batch-performance trending to identify emerging risks, assess process robustness, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Lead technical assessment and approval of change controls, risk assessments, comparability assessments, process updates, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Partner with Manufacturing Operations and Supply Chain to assess technical constraints, manage manufacturing and supply risks, and develop recovery or mitigation plans.
* Lead technical governance with CDMOs/CMOs, including performance review, issue escalation, technical decision-making, data review, and follow-up of technical deliverables.
* Collaborate with MS&T, Quality, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure technical strategies align with process-validation requirements, cGMP expectations, regulatory commitments, and product lifecycle plans.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that enhance process robustness, product quality, yield, manufacturing efficiency, and supply reliability.
* Develop, mentor, and provide technical directions to Manufacturing Technical Services staff and matrixed technical teams.
* Travel to support on-site manufacturing activities, CDMO/CMO operations, audits, inspections, and business needs as required (10-20% travel expected)

**Knowledge and Skills**
------------------------

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, testing, controls, and commercial manufacturing operations for Spray Dried Dispersion (SDD)
* Strong knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices, pharmaceutical quality systems, and controlled-documentation requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with commercial manufacturing support, technical services, process monitoring, product lifecycle management, and external manufacturing oversight.
* Advanced experience leading complex technical investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, change controls, risk assessments, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Ability to interpret manufacturing, process, and analytical data; identify process-performance trends; assess technical risks; and recommend practical, sustainable solutions.
* Understanding of manufacturing operations, maintenance, engineering, equipment performance, capacity constraints, and supply-continuity planning.
* Experience leading CDMO/CMO technical relationships, including governance, performance management, technical issue resolution, and escalation.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, strategic-thinking, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and relevant manufacturing or business systems.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, or a related scientific or technical discipline.
* Typically requires 8+ years of experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, chemical, or another regulated manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant experience supporting commercial manufacturing operations, technical services, MS&T, process development, engineering, quality, or external manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical programs, manufacturing workstreams, complex investigations, process improvements, or cross-functional teams.
* Experience working in a cGMP environment and supporting controlled manufacturing documentation is required.
Demonstrate people leadership, matrix leadership, or technical leadership experience is required. 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$138,700 - $208,100

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

records.title: Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems
records.description:
***Who We Are:***

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

***What We Do:***

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our late-stage azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal seizures (FS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also are investigating azetukalner in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel ion channel candidates, including studies of XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

***About the Role:***

We are seeking a **Manager/Senior Manager, Global Quality Systems,** who will provide leadership and oversight across key Quality Management System (QMS) processes, including quality events, investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control. This role will serve as a key quality partner across GxP functions, helping to identify systemic issues, strengthen investigation practices, and drive sustainable, risk-based improvements that support compliance, inspection readiness, and operational excellence. The role will work closely with internal teams and external service providers across Xenon’s outsourced operating model to ensure the QMS remains effective, compliant, and inspection ready.

The ideal candidate will bring strong Quality Systems experience, broad GxP knowledge, and sound business judgment, with the ability to effectively challenge investigations, facilitate meaningful root cause analysis, and influence stakeholders across functions. The role will also support quality governance, QMS metrics and trending, change control review, and the continued optimization of electronic quality systems.

This position reports to the Associate Director, Quality Assurance, Systems and will be based out of Boston, MA, USA in our Needham office. This role is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of two onsite days per week. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Systems & Governance**

 + Manage the oversight, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of GxP Quality Systems, including quality events, investigations, CAPA, change control, and associated governance processes.
 + Ensure consistent, risk-based practices for investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change management, including review and approval of records and escalation of significant quality or compliance risks.
 + Monitor QMS performance through metrics, trending, CAPA effectiveness, and Quality Management Review reporting to identify systemic risks and drive continuous improvement.
* **Compliance, Inspection Readiness & eQMS**

 + Assess QMS processes and proposed changes for GxP, regulatory, validation, training, documentation, and data integrity considerations, maintaining alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations.
 + Support the administration, optimization, validation, upgrades, and continuous improvement of the eQMS and associated procedures, guidance, and training.
 + Support regulatory inspections and internal and external audits, including inspection readiness and responses to observations and findings.
* **Quality Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

 + Provide Quality Systems expertise, guidance, coaching, and training to promote consistent, inspection-ready, and risk-based quality practices across the organization.
 + Partner with GxP functions and external service providers to establish quality expectations, resolve quality issues, implement compliant changes and CAPAs, and drive cross-functional quality improvement initiatives.
 + Promote a strong quality culture through effective stakeholder engagement, sound judgment, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* **General Responsibilities**

 + Act in accordance with Company policies, including the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and ensure applicable policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any.
 + Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated industry, with demonstrated experience in Quality Systems, Quality Assurance, or compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with quality event management, including complex investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control.
* Strong working knowledge of QMS requirements, quality risk management principles, and applicable GxP regulations, including GMP and familiarity with GCP, GVP, and GLP.
* Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems such as Veeva Quality, MasterControl, or equivalent, including supporting system implementation, optimization, or maintenance.
* Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining quality procedures, SOPs, metrics, and trending to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting quality governance activities, regulatory inspections, internal or external audits, and inspection readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders while effectively navigating ambiguity and driving quality initiatives to completion.
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to execution.
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

Compensation Range: $131.3K - $173.3K
